title: Wholesale Accounts & Sales Coordinator
description: ABOUT PUFF HERBALS: Puff Herbals is a growing U.S.-based herbal wellness brand creating thoughtfully formulated herbal cigarettes and smoking blends. Our products are completely tobacco-free, cannabis-free, and additive-free. We sell directly to customers through our e-commerce store and through independent retailers across the United States. We are looking for a proactive, organized, and relationship-focused Wholesale Accounts & Sales Coordinator to help us support our existing retailers and expand our wholesale business. ABOUT THE ROLE: This role combines wholesale account support, retailer research, sales outreach, order processing, and pipeline management. You will communicate with current and prospective retailers, help manage wholesale orders and reorders, identify aligned stores, conduct thoughtful outreach, coordinate samples, and maintain organized records of wholesale activity. You will also help create and maintain a central retailer database so that current accounts, prospective accounts, conversations, orders, and follow-ups can be viewed at a glance. This is not a high-pressure cold-calling position. We are looking for someone who understands relationship-based sales, communicates warmly and professionally, and follows up consistently. You will work directly with the founder and receive training on Puff Herbals’ products, brand voice, wholesale policies, target retailers, and sales approach. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Wholesale Account Support - Manage routine communication with current wholesale retailers - Monitor the wholesale inbox and respond to retailer questions - Help retailers place opening orders and reorders - Process wholesale orders accurately through Shopify - Conduct personalized retailer check-ins and reorder outreach - Identify inactive accounts that may be ready to reorder - Maintain positive and thoughtful relationships with retail partners - Escalate major opportunities, negotiations, or unusual requests to the founder - Retailer Research and Lead Generation - Research independent retailers that align with the Puff Herbals brand and customer - Identify prospects such as apothecaries, herbal shops, wellness boutiques, gift stores, lifestyle retailers, smoke shops, and other specialty stores - Review prospective retailers’ websites, social media, existing product assortment, and overall customer fit - Find accurate buyer or store-owner contact information - Use Overjoy and other approved research tools to build targeted prospect lists - Prioritize qualified, relevant retailers rather than focusing only on lead volume WHOLESALE SALES OUTREACH: - Conduct thoughtful outreach to prospective retailers through email and other approved channels - Personalize outreach when appropriate - Manage follow-up sequences consistently and professionally - Respond to interested retailers and provide approved wholesale information - Coordinate sample requests and follow up after samples are received - Keep prospective retailers moving through the sales pipeline - Schedule qualified retailer calls with the founder when needed - Conduct limited phone outreach when appropriate - Retailer Database and Pipeline Management - Create and maintain a central retailer and prospect database - Organize current, former, prospective, and newly opened wholesale accounts - Import and clean relevant retailer information from Shopify and existing records - Track outreach, responses, follow-ups, samples, orders, account status, and next steps - Ensure every active account and prospect has a clear status and next action - Provide a simple weekly update covering outreach activity, responses, opportunities, opening orders, reorders, and anything requiring founder input OVERJOY AND WHOLESALE SYSTEMS: - Learn and use Overjoy to research retailers and manage outbound outreach - Complete available platform training and independently learn unfamiliar features - Work with the founder and Overjoy support team to improve the existing outreach setup - Build small, targeted lead lists and campaigns before increasing outreach volume - Monitor lead quality, replies, and sales results - Help improve outreach messaging based on performance - Document repeatable workflows through written SOPs or Loom videos - Keep wholesale line sheets, price lists, templates, and retailer materials organized and current WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: - Excellent written and spoken English - Experience in sales support, wholesale, lead generation, account management, business development, e-commerce, or customer service - Strong research skills and good judgment when evaluating retailer fit - Warm, polished, and professional written communication - Excellent organization and consistent follow-through - Comfortable conducting outbound outreach on behalf of a brand - Comfortable learning new software independently - Strong Google Sheets or spreadsheet skills - High attention to detail when processing orders and communicating product or pricing information - Able to work independently and identify next steps without constant direction - Comfortable working directly with a founder in a growing small business - Experience with Shopify, CRMs, sales outreach tools, Overjoy, CPG brands, wellness products, or independent retail is preferred but not required. - Applicants must be comfortable working in herbal smoking products. SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION: - This role will begin at approximately 10–15 hours per week. The schedule is flexible, although the work should generally be completed throughout the Monday-to-Friday workweek so that retailer messages and follow-ups are handled consistently. - Compensation is $10–$12 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience and skill level. - After the initial training period, there may also be opportunities to earn performance bonuses connected to qualified new wholesale accounts and successful account reorders. - This is intended to be a long-term role. There is potential for increased hours and responsibility as Puff Herbals’ wholesale business grows. HOW TO APPLY: Please include the following in your application: 1. A brief introduction. 2. A summary of your most relevant experience in wholesale, sales outreach, lead generation, account management, e-commerce, or customer service. Please only apply if you are comfortable with the posted compensation, part-time hours, and working with herbal smoking products. Please begin your application with “octopus” so we know you read the full posting. Selected applicants will be contacted for the next stage of the hiring process. Finalists will be invited to complete a brief paid skills assessment.

title: Audience Editor (Editorial & Community Distribution)
description: We're looking for an Audience Editor to help ensure our journalism reaches the widest possible audience. This is a hybrid editorial and audience-growth role combining copy editing, headline optimisation, publishing and community distribution. You'll work closely with reporters and editors to refine content, identify the best audience opportunities, and strategically distribute articles across platforms including Reddit. The ideal candidate understands both what makes a strong story and how to get readers to engage with it. Performance & Growth > Monitor article performance across traffic sources. > Identify stories with strong Reddit, Discover, News or social potential. > Feed audience insights back into editorial planning. > Help editors understand which content resonates with specific communities. > Contribute ideas for increasing reader engagement and loyalty. What We're Looking For Essential > Excellent copy editing and proofreading skills. > Strong understanding of news values and editorial judgement. > Experience publishing digital content. > Familiarity with Reddit and online communities. > Understanding of SEO best practices. > Ability to write compelling headlines and audience-facing copy. > Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Desirable > Experience working in a digital newsroom. > Knowledge of US, UK and Canadian news audiences. > Understanding of Google Discover and audience development strategies. Success In This Role After 90 days, you will: > Consistently publish and optimise high-quality content. > Successfully identify Reddit opportunities for relevant stories. > Help increase audience engagement and referral traffic. > Act as a bridge between editorial quality and audience growth. > Contribute directly to traffic, reader loyalty and newsroom performance.

I am looking to hire someone who can assist me in researching and planning my itinerary before we arrive (so will technically be my VA before arriving).  They will then meet us upon arrival and will act as my Personal Assistant for the duration of our stay.  Then after we leave, they will follow-up with closing out and finishing any unfinished business left there. The job will pay an hourly rate based on the number of hours available and worked prior to our arrival .. then will pay a flat rate for the duration of our stay there, followed by an indeterminate amount after we leave based on the work required. For the most part, while there, the PA will go wherever I go and spend everyday with me.  They will be given time each day for themselves of-course, but will need to be flexible depending on circumstances.  We will be bringing our children, so there will also be some days dedicated to spending time with the family (e.g. Enchanted Kingdom, etc). There will be some days that my wife and I may plan to leave the kids behind and visit certain places as well (e.g. Floating Restaurant in Bohol, etc).  Other times, my wife may wish to go off into the province and visit her relatives (which I definitely do not like doing), so I may d ---------- to travel by myself to exotic locations around the Philippines, play golf, or just hit up the local malls.  Due to the time difference, I also tend to be a night owl there, and enjoy hitting up clubs/bars/KTVs for some nightly entertainment. There are too many things to list out, but regardless of where we go and what I do, the PA's job will be to always make sure to be by my side, ensure that I make it safely to whatever destination we go, ensure I have a fun and enjoyable time, and ensure I always return home safely.  This may include running small errands (e.g. getting food/medicine) and occasionally traveling by themselves (e.g. meeting a venue owner to finalize details). But 95% of the time they will be at my side. There are other things that may be involved (e.g. lodging arrangements and travel accommodations) that will also be discussed in the interview. But I will cover all expenses for everything; including food, accommodations, travel, and personal expenses.  Including also the salary, which will be discussed and d ---------- based on skills, experience, and meeting requirements. Previous experience is not necessary. The main things that matter the most are: - Understand/Speak English for long periods of time - Honesty and Loyalty to me - Willing to go where I want to go, do what I want to do, and ensure I enjoy myself going/doing it - A consistently positive attitude and eager to please - An adventurous spirit and willing to go places and do things never done before - Being flexible and adaptable as things change (as they always do in the Philippines) - Willing to put in the work and effort to ensure we have a great and smooth vacation People who are naturally open and conversational will also have a great advantage (e.g. Westerners love to socialize) All are welcome to apply no matter the location, gender, age, religion, or marital status. Additionally, my wife is from Davao, so Bisaya/Cebuano will give you an advantage with her, though not required for me. - But I am open to considering any and all who wish to apply. If you think you might enjoy traveling the country, accompanying one of the world's greatest bosses, and visiting some of the nicest places the Philippines has to offer, all at my expense ... then I invite you to click on the link and fill out our short application form here: ---------- You may also email me at ---------- - be sure to include your OnlineJobs profile link, FB, and WhatsApp. Though filling out the online application will get better response times. description: Do not apply unless you have maximum confidence in your ability to deliver results. We will ask for proof. Ensure you read the whole description. Media Buyer — Meta Ads Specialist Reports to: Head of Growth / Marketing Director Full-time | Performance Marketing | Paid Social About the role We're looking for a results-driven, high-performance Media Buyer who lives and breathes Meta advertising. You've managed substantial budgets, know how to scale without blowing ROAS, and can back everything up with hard data. If you've turned paid social into a predictable growth engine, we want to talk. At a glance Minimum ROAS: 3.0+ Monthly spend managed: $10k+ Experience required: 2+ years Meta Ads Track record: Proven ability to scale Key responsibilities Own end-to-end campaign management across Meta Ads Manager — from strategy and build to optimisation and reporting, across multiple accounts simultaneously. Strategically scale ad spend — increasing budgets and expanding audiences while maintaining a minimum 3.0 ROAS, using proven budget-pacing and bid management techniques. Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across creative, copy, audiences, landing pages, and offers — building a clear testing log and acting on results with speed. Brief and collaborate with the creative team to produce high-converting ad assets — you understand what makes a Meta ad stop the scroll and drive conversions, and you can communicate that clearly. Monitor account health daily — diagnosing performance drops, frequency issues, audience fatigue, and delivery problems before they impact results. Build and manage full-funnel campaign structures — prospecting (TOF), retargeting (MOF/BOF), and retention — with a clear understanding of how each layer interacts. Set up and maintain accurate tracking — Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), custom events, and UTM parameters — ensuring data integrity across all campaigns. Deliver clear weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights — no vanity metrics, just ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and the story they tell. Stay ahead of Meta platform updates, algorithm changes, and new ad formats — proactively adapting strategy before performance is affected. What we require Proven spend experience: you must have personally managed Meta ad accounts at $10k+ monthly spend. You'll be asked to provide account-level results, not agency-level attribution. Demonstrated ROAS performance: a consistent track record of sustaining 3.0+ ROAS at scale. You must be able to show this with real data. Deep Meta Ads Manager expertise: campaign objective selection, CBO vs ABO strategy, Advantage+ campaigns, broad vs interest targeting, lookalike audiences, and manual vs automated bidding. Scaling methodology: you have a clear, repeatable process for scaling budgets — whether through horizontal expansion, budget multipliers, or audience diversification — without destabilising campaigns. Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with GA4, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar attribution tools. You don't just read dashboards — you interrogate data to form hypotheses. Tracking & measurement fluency: solid understanding of iOS 14+ attribution impact, CAPI implementation, and how to maintain reporting accuracy in a privacy-first landscape. Creative instinct: you understand performance creative — hooks, UGC formats, video vs static — and can brief a team or give concrete, actionable feedback on ad assets. Self-sufficient and accountable: you flag problems early, own outcomes, and don't wait for direction. You manage your accounts like they're your own business. Nice to have Experience running Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or YouTube alongside Meta as part of a blended paid strategy. Experience in DTC / e-commerce environments where ROAS and blended MER are primary KPIs. Shopify analytics experience and understanding of how paid social integrates with on-site conversion rate. Experience managing multiple client accounts with varying spend levels, verticals, and objectives. Meta Blueprint certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise. Interview process Application review — Submit a brief summary of your highest-spend account, the ROAS achieved, and how you scaled it. Intro call (30 min) — Walk us through your experience, biggest wins, and how you think about scaling. Paid task / case study — A short paid exercise: audit a real or sample account and present your findings and action plan. Final interview — Deep dive with the hiring manager. We'll go through your case study and align on strategy. Important note We take results seriously. During the process, you'll be expected to share real performance data (anonymised if needed) that validates your experience. Candidates who cannot demonstrate their ROAS track record with data will not progress

title: Aviation / B2B Ghostwriter (Remote, Long-Term) - We Built the Machine, You Bring the Magic
job_title: Aviation / B2B Ghostwriter (Remote, Long-Term) - We Built the Machine, You Bring the Magic
description: We're a marketing studio. We ghostwrite LinkedIn posts, email newsletters, and ads (plus other things) for B2B founders in the aviation, career consulting, finance, and home-preparedness markets. We've already built the machine: custom AI tools (Claude plus our tailored ghostwriting skills) and a library of hundreds of client call transcripts to pull stories, ideas, and angles from. But there's a problem with the machine, and it's the entire reason this job exists. Our AI system produces technically accurate, on-brand copy. It'll get you the ideas. It gets the facts right and the structure close enough... But what it cannot do is make someone FEEL something. The emotional storytelling, the visual detail that puts a reader inside a ---------- nt, the human ache that makes a post stop the scroll: that has to come from a person. That person is who we're hiring. So you're not starting from a blank page. We have the AI to hand you the ideas, and we'll work together to build the content calendar. What we need from you is the writing skill to leverage the AI and produce the one thing machines can't: emotion, story, and visual texture. What you'll actually do: - Mine our client's call transcripts for the ---------- nts mentioned above: the turning point, the fear, the win, the detail nobody else would notice - Work with me (and ideally, over time, on your own) to draft the content calendar and the week's ideas - Run our Claude ghostwriting skills to shape and structure the draft. The skill keeps evolving, so your input on improving the system is welcome and encouraged Then do the part that only you can do: - With your edits, layer in the emotional storytelling and visual, sensory detail that makes it resonate - Fact-check every claim against the source. We write about people, companies, and industry data, so accuracy is non-negotiable - Deliver on the content calendar a week ahead of publish date. Volume: Minimum is 8 LinkedIn posts and ~5 email s per week. Once you're ramped and the system's dialed in, there's plenty more: sales pages, ads, additional email work, and eventually copy for our own home-preparedness brand. This grows for the right person. The bar: the founder reads it and goes "that's exactly how I'd say it, this gave me goosebumps." Then I do one light proof pass and it ships. If I'm rewriting your drafts, it's not working out... You're a fit if you: - Write genuinely emotional, story-driven copy in native-level English. - This is the #1, non-negotiable requirement. Show me writing that made someone feel something. - Have real instinct for story: you can hear a 5-minute anecdote and instantly know the emotional hook - Use AI writing tools like Claude as a drafting partner, not a replacement for your own voice and skill - Are obsessive about factual accuracy, attention to detail, and deadlines. This means being reliable and consistent week over week. - I value steady, dependable output over occasional brilliance that fades over time. - Will be honest with me: I've hired talented writers who started strong and faded after a few weeks or months. - I'm looking for someone consistently good who'll be with us long-term. - Take direct feedback without getting upset, knowing we both want the same thing: content that keeps clients around long-term and grows both our incomes Bonus if you've: - Ghostwritten for personal brands, LinkedIn, or newsletters before - Have any exposure to aviation, career coaching, or finance - And experience turning interview or transcript material into content Logistics Remote, long-term, ongoing relationship $800/month to start, raises available and can go up for the right person. I'd rather find someone great and pay them more over time than start cheap and burn through people. Mostly async, but a quick weekly call for content planning (at least early on) would be ideal Begins with a paid trial (below) How to apply: Start your reply with the word CHILLS so I know you read the whole thing. Paste ONE piece of your writing that made a reader feel something, and in one sentence, tell me what emotion you were going for and why it worked. Here's a flat, boring fact. Rewrite it as 2-3 sentences with emotion and visual detail, the way you'd open a post: "A pilot we coached got a job offer from a regional airline after being unemployed for 8 months." Paid trial: Strong applicants get a strong, paid two-week trial. I'll send you call transcripts, our voice guide, and our Claude skill, and you'll produce several posts across the two weeks. I'll of course pay you for the full two weeks. It's how I see how you actually work, and how you find out if you enjoy the system.

description: Genesis Pain Clinic is a US-based interventional pain management practice looking for a full-time Senior Medical Biller / Revenue Cycle Management Specialist. Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM US Central Time 40 hours per week Full-time, dedicated role Pay: $7-$11 USD per hour, depending on verified experience This is a hands-on provider-side medical billing role. We are looking for someone who already has real US medical billing experience and can work independently inside eClinicalWorks. This is not a general VA role. This is not an entry-level billing role. This is not a flexible-hours or part-time role. The right person should be able to review claims, identify billing problems, work denials, follow up with payers, document clearly, and keep the revenue cycle moving without needing constant step-by-step instructions. -------------------------------------------------- REQUIRED EXPERIENCE -------------------------------------------------- - Minimum 3 to 5 years of US medical billing / RCM experience - Hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience required - Provider-side outpatient clinic billing experience preferred - Experience with claim submission, claim scrubbing, payment posting, manual posting, denials, appeals, reconsiderations, and AR follow-up - Comfortable using payer portals and calling insurance companies - Comfortable with CPT, ICD-10, modifiers, units, place of service, and authorization requirements - Able to document payer calls, reference numbers, claim notes, and next follow-up dates - Able to work full-time during US Central Time business hours - Reliable internet, backup internet, and backup power required -------------------------------------------------- STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE -------------------------------------------------- - Pain management billing - Interventional procedure billing - Workers' Compensation billing - Orthopedic, spine, neurology, PM&R, or specialty billing - Medicare, Medicare Advantage, commercial insurance, and out-of-network billing - Prior authorizations for procedures - Medical necessity appeals - Payment posting and underpayment review - Coding certification or strong coding knowledge -------------------------------------------------- MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES -------------------------------------------------- You should be able to independently handle most of the following: - Verification of benefits / eligibility - Prior authorization / pre-authorization - Claim submission - Claim scrubbing - Clearinghouse rejection correction - Payment posting from ERA/EOB - Manual payment posting - Contractual adjustments - Denial management - Corrected claims - Appeals and reconsiderations - AR follow-up - Medical records requests - Payer portal follow-up - Workers' Compensation claim follow-up - Daily productivity reporting -------------------------------------------------- eCLINICALWORKS REQUIREMENT -------------------------------------------------- Hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience is required. Please do not apply if you only used eCW for scheduling, only watched eCW videos, or only have basic exposure. We need someone who understands the billing side of eCW. You should be comfortable with eCW workflows such as: - Claim review - Claim submission - Claim status - Claim notes - Payment posting - Denial tracking - Corrected claims - AR follow-up - Attaching or referencing payer documentation -------------------------------------------------- PAIN MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE -------------------------------------------------- Pain management billing experience is a strong advantage. Examples of procedures we may bill include: - Epidural steroid injections - Medial branch blocks - Radiofrequency ablation - SI joint injections - Trigger point injections - Large joint injections - Fluoroscopy-guided procedures - Ultrasound-guided procedures - Urine drug testing You do not need to know every pain procedure on day one, but you must be comfortable learning payer rules, CPT/modifier issues, authorization requirements, and documentation requirements. -------------------------------------------------- WORKERS' COMPENSATION -------------------------------------------------- Workers' Compensation billing experience is strongly preferred. Helpful experience includes: - Claim numbers - Date of injury - Adjusters - Nurse case managers - Authorizations - EOR/EOB review - Records requests - Underpayment follow-up - Reconsiderations - Appeals - Payer-specific Workers' Compensation processes -------------------------------------------------- FULL-TIME DEDICATED ROLE / NO OVEREMPLOYMENT -------------------------------------------------- This is a full-time dedicated role during our scheduled work hours. During paid working hours, you may not: - Work for another client - Work for another agency - Work another job - Monitor another client's messages - Keep another work laptop open - Attend another client's meetings - Run another time tracker - Subcontract your work - Share logins Before hire, you must disclose all current clients, employers, agencies, freelance work, and recurring paid obligations. Another job that overlaps with 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time is disqualifying. This role is not compatible with overemployment, double-jobbing, mouse jigglers, fake activity, or time padding. -------------------------------------------------- TIME TRACKING AND COMMUNICATION -------------------------------------------------- Time Doctor will be required. We may review: - Screenshots - Activity levels - App usage - Website usage - eCW activity - Payer portal activity - Teams responsiveness - Daily output reports Time Doctor activity alone is not enough. Paid time must match real billing output. Manual time is not allowed unless approved. During scheduled hours, you must be reachable on Microsoft Teams. Normal response expectation is within 5 minutes unless you are on a payer call, in a meeting, or have already documented why you are unavailable. -------------------------------------------------- DAILY REPORTING -------------------------------------------------- At the end of each workday, you will send a short productivity report showing what was completed, what is pending, and what is blocked. Your report may include: - Claims submitted - Claims corrected - Denials worked - Appeals or reconsiderations submitted - Payments posted - Manual payments posted - AR accounts worked - Prior authorizations submitted or followed up - VOBs completed - Payer calls completed - Reference numbers obtained - Issues needing provider or administrator review -------------------------------------------------- SELECTION PROCESS -------------------------------------------------- Qualified applicants may be asked to complete: - Written screening questions - Short video interview - Live eClinicalWorks / RCM technical interview - Live screen-share workflow test - Paid practical billing test - 5-day paid evaluation period - 30-day probationary period We are not hiring based only on interview confidence. We are hiring based on demonstrated skill, reliability, integrity, and actual work output. -------------------------------------------------- HOW TO APPLY -------------------------------------------------- Your application will only be considered if you follow these instructions. The first line of your application must be: ECW RCM DEDICATED Then answer these questions: 1. How many years of US provider-side medical billing / RCM experience do you have? Which specialties have you billed for? 2. How many years of hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience do you have? List the exact billing tasks you personally performed inside eCW. 3. Which RCM tasks can you perform independently? Examples: VOB, prior auth, claim submission, claim scrubbing, payment posting, manual posting, denial management, appeals, AR follow-up, records requests. 4. Describe a denial you fixed from start to finish. What was the denial, what did you check, what action did you take, and how did you document it? 5. Explain your payment posting experience. Have you posted ERAs/EOBs and manual payments? Have you identified underpayments, duplicate posting, contractual adjustments, or recoupments? 6. Describe your Workers' Compensation billing experience, if any. 7. Which payer portals and clearinghouse portals have you personally used? Examples: Availity, UHC, Optum, Medicare, Medicaid, BCBS, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, Workers' Compensation portals, TriZetto, Office Ally, or other clearinghouses. 8. Are you currently working for any other client, employer, agency, or freelance project? If yes, list your exact schedule and whether it overlaps with 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time. 9. Confirm that you are comfortable with Time Doctor, screenshots, activity tracking, daily productivity reports, Teams responsiveness, and live screen-sharing when requested. 10. What is your requested hourly rate in USD? Mini Test Question: A claim for a lumbar radiofrequency ablation is denied for CO-50, medical necessity. description: Speck of Dust is a video production company in Sydney, Australia, working across documentary, sport and live-event content. PLEASE READ THIS IN FULL BEFORE APPLYING. We receive a lot of generic, copy-paste applications, and we only consider people who are a genuine fit. Apply only if you are a genuine video editor with a real video editing reel. This is NOT a role for generalists, web or graphic designers, AI-content creators, or social-media content editors. If that is your background, please do not apply. We are looking for a remote video editor, and we like to start with a single paid trial project so we can both see if it is a good fit. This first project is small (budget around US$150 to US$300). Only if it goes well would we then talk about more project work and, in time, a possible ongoing monthly arrangement. There is no immediate or permanent commitment up front, and nothing is locked in. THE WORK (the trial project). It is a fun, upbeat highlight edit of an event night: the kind of piece that gives the people who took part a great memory to watch back and share. It is a single-camera job. You cut the best ---------- nts down into selects and assemble them into a finished piece of around 90 seconds (two minutes maximum). It opens with a short presenter introduction, moves through people arriving and enjoying the experience, carries a short interview section around the halfway mark, and builds to a high point before closing on a sponsor logo we supply. The feel is celebratory and energetic, driven by well-known upbeat pop music, with the cuts and speed ramps timed to the rhythm. Golden ---------- nts are kept in their original slow motion. The footage is shot on a Canon C400 (C-Log2 profile) and you apply a LUT we provide before any grading. We give you reference edits to match for pacing, structure and feel, so you are not starting from a blank page. It is edited in Premiere Pro, you hand back the Premiere project file, and review happens in ---------- with time-coded notes (one revision round on the trial). Beyond this first project, our work overall ranges from emotionally driven, story-led documentary pieces through to fast, energetic sport and event edits. WHAT THIS IS NOT. We are not looking for a generalist social-media editor. If your main experience is editing for YouTubers, Instagram, or short-form social (for example CapCut-style content), we are probably not the right fit. We don't do disposable, templated clips with tacky graphics, gimmicky sound effects, or AI-generated filler. We want a genuine video editor who specialises in considered, brief-led craft: emotional, story-led documentary work and cinematic, high-energy sport. Every piece is made to a specific brief, with real storytelling, craft and taste. TWO THINGS WE WEIGH HEAVILY (these are core to the role, not nice-to-haves): 1. A strong, fluent command of English, written and spoken. We will assess this on a short video call. 2. A genuine video editor specialising in craft work, shown in a real editing reel, not generalist, social-media, web or graphic-design work. YOU MUST HAVE (please be honest, this is where we have had trouble before): - A computer that can genuinely handle large-format Canon C400 footage (.mxf, C-Log2) in Premiere Pro, with a proxy workflow if needed. - Plenty of fast, free storage. Jobs are often 400GB or more. - A fast, reliable internet connection. You will be downloading large media and that download time is real. - Confidence with the ---------- Transfer app and the Google Drive app, and with relinking media in Premiere. - Premiere Pro, and you hand back the Premiere project file on delivery. - Comfortable applying a supplied LUT, working with slow motion and speed ramps, and cutting to music. - Organised and reliable, and comfortable communicating day to day on Google Chat or WhatsApp. - Able to take feedback through ---------- time-coded notes and action it properly. A BONUS (not a dealbreaker): After Effects and a sophisticated hand with visual effects. TO APPLY, please include: 1. Two or three of your most relevant samples as direct video links (for example Vimeo or an unlisted YouTube link), ideally matching our work: one story-led emotional edit and one high-energy sport edit. If you do not have directly relevant work, send your strongest pieces instead. Please do NOT send a full Google Drive folder with endless lists and subfolders for us to dig through; pick your best two or three and link them directly. It must be genuine video editing work. 2. Your computer specs and storage. 3. Your internet speed. 4. Your rate for a single project like this, and your monthly rate if we were ever to move to ongoing work. 5. References and proof of the work and credentials you mention. 6. One thing from this brief that stood out to you, in a sentence, so we know you have actually read it. We read every application and can tell a copy-paste from a real one. Applications that clearly ignore this brief, or whose work is not genuine video editing, will not be considered. A short video call is the next step so we can have a chat. THE DEAL. We start with this one paid trial project. If it works, we would love to keep working together on more projects and possibly an ongoing monthly arrangement later, but nothing is committed or locked in up front. Every editor we engage signs a short agreement: nothing you edit for us is used in their own promotion, and they do not approach our clients directly. This is standard on every job.

title: Part-Time Shopify Store Creator (3 Hours/Day) – Long-Term Opportunity
job_title: Part-Time Shopify Store Creator (3 Hours/Day) – Long-Term Opportunity
description: # **Créateur de sites Shopify (Temps partiel – 3 heures par jour / 21 heures par semaine)** ## À propos du poste Nous recherchons un **créateur de sites Shopify expérimenté** pour rejoindre notre équipe en **temps partiel (3 heures par jour, 7 jours par semaine, soit environ 21 heures par semaine)**. Notre fonctionnement est simple : nous lançons en moyenne **3 nouveaux produits par semaine** en phase de test. Certaines semaines, il peut y en avoir un peu moins ou un peu plus, mais c'est notre rythme habituel. Avec une charge de travail de **21 heures par semaine** pour environ **3 produits**, cela représente **environ 7 heures de travail par produit**. Pour chaque produit, il faudra généralement : * Recréer une page produit Shopify. * Recréer un **listicle (page de prévente)**. Nous estimons que **7 heures sont largement suffisantes** pour réaliser ce travail, puisque dans la majorité des cas il s'agit essentiellement de reproduire le travail d'un concurrent et de l'adapter à notre marque ainsi qu'au marché canadien. ## Vos missions Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : * Recréer des pages produits Shopify performantes. * Remplacer le branding du concurrent par le nôtre (logo, nom de la marque, etc.). * Recréer des **listicles (pages de prévente)** en reprenant la structure du concurrent. * Adapter le contenu du marché américain au marché canadien. Cela comprend notamment : * Remplacer les prix en dollars américains (USD) par des dollars canadiens (CAD). * Adapter les prix sur l'ensemble de la page. * Remplacer les villes ou références américaines par des villes canadiennes lorsque cela est pertinent. * Veiller à ce que chaque page soit professionnelle et aussi fidèle que possible à la mise en page originale. En résumé, votre travail consistera principalement à **reproduire des pages Shopify et des listicles qui fonctionnent déjà, tout en les adaptant à notre marque et au marché canadien.** ## Outils Vous utiliserez **ChatGPT Premium**, que nous mettrons à votre disposition. L'intelligence artificielle vous aidera à adapter les textes et à travailler plus rapidement. ## Profil recherché **Merci de ne pas postuler si :** * Vous n'avez jamais créé de sites ou de pages produits Shopify. * Vous ne savez pas recréer une page Shopify existante. * Vous ne savez pas ce qu'est un **listicle (page de prévente)**. * Vous n'avez aucune expérience dans la reproduction ou la création de pages Shopify. La maîtrise de l'anglais **n'est pas obligatoire**, car les outils d'intelligence artificielle, notamment ChatGPT, facilitent énormément le travail. En revanche, avoir un bon niveau d'anglais est un véritable avantage et vous permettra de travailler plus efficacement. ## Ce que nous recherchons * Une expérience concrète sur Shopify. * De l'autonomie. * Un grand souci du détail. * Une bonne rapidité d'exécution. * Une personne sérieuse, organisée et fiable. Si vous avez déjà de l'expérience dans la création de sites Shopify et la reproduction de pages performantes, nous serons ravis d'étudier votre candidature. N'hésitez pas à nous présenter votre expérience lors de votre candidature.

Requirements & Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in international VAT compliance (specifically EU VAT) and full-cycle bookkeeping. Excel Mastery (Non-Negotiable): Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel is a must. description: Medical Credentialing Specialist Credentialing / Provider Services Reports To:  CEO Employment Type:  Full-Time Location:  Remote Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Medical Credentialing Specialist to own and lead the credentialing function for our practice with minimal day-to-day supervision. This person will manage the full credentialing and payer enrollment lifecycle for all providers, partner closely with the billing team to keep providers compliant and in-network, and serve as the subject-matter expert the rest of the team relies on. In addition to leading credentialing, this role supports our front desk operations. The specialist will answer phones and schedule patient appointments when calls roll over from the front desk, and will step in to support other front-desk functions as needed. The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable balancing detailed compliance work with patient-facing support. Key Responsibilities Credentialing & Provider Enrollment (Primary) • Take charge of the practice's credentialing operations independently, managing the complete lifecycle for all providers from initial credentialing through re-credentialing. • Complete and submit initial credentialing, re-credentialing, and payer enrollment applications for commercial and government payers (Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care plans). • Maintain and update provider profiles in CAQH ProView, PECOS, NPPES/NPI, and payer portals, ensuring all information is accurate and current. • Perform primary source verification of licenses, education, training, board certifications, work history, and malpractice coverage. • Track and proactively manage expirables — state licenses, DEA registrations, board certifications, malpractice insurance, and other time-sensitive credentials — and renew them ahead of deadlines to prevent lapses. • Maintain organized, audit-ready provider files and credentialing records in compliance with applicable standards (e.g., NCQA, Joint Commission, CMS, and payer requirements). • Monitor application status, follow up persistently with payers, and resolve issues to keep enrollment moving and minimize delays. • Serve as the internal point of contact and resource on credentialing questions, escalations, and process improvements. Billing & Compliance Collaboration • Work closely with the billing team to ensure providers remain in compliance with all credentialing and enrollment requirements so that claims can be submitted and reimbursed without disruption. • Communicate provider effective dates, network participation status, and enrollment changes to billing in a timely manner. • Help research and resolve claim denials or holds tied to credentialing or enrollment issues. • Keep leadership and billing informed of upcoming renewals, compliance risks, and any gaps that could affect reimbursement. Front Desk & Patient Support (Secondary) • Answer incoming phone calls that roll over from the front desk, providing courteous and professional service to patients. • Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments accurately. • Support additional front-desk functions as needed, such as patient check-in/check-out, verifying demographic and insurance information, and responding to general patient inquiries. • Provide coverage and backup for front-desk staff during high-volume periods, breaks, or absences. Required Qualifications • 3+ years of hands-on medical credentialing and/or payer enrollment experience. • Demonstrated ability to manage credentialing operations independently with minimal supervision. • Working knowledge of credentialing standards and regulatory requirements (NCQA, CMS, Joint Commission, and payer-specific guidelines). • Proficiency with CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and commercial/government payer enrollment portals. • Strong understanding of how credentialing and enrollment affect billing and reimbursement. • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to track many deadlines simultaneously. • Professional verbal and written communication skills and a patient-friendly phone manner. • Comfortable using practice management and/or credentialing software, EHR systems, and standard office applications. • High level of discretion and the ability to handle confidential provider and patient information in compliance with HIPAA. Preferred Qualifications • CPCS (Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist) or CPMSM (Certified Professional Medical Services Management) certification through NAMSS or equivalent experience. • Prior experience in a lead or senior credentialing role. • Front desk, scheduling, or patient-facing healthcare experience. • Familiarity with the specialties and payers relevant to our practice. Core Competencies • Ownership & autonomy — takes initiative and drives the credentialing function forward without needing close oversight. • Detail & accuracy — treats deadlines and documentation as non-negotiable. • Collaboration — works seamlessly across credentialing, billing, and front-desk teams. • Adaptability — moves comfortably between focused compliance work and patient-facing support. • Customer service — represents the practice professionally to patients and payers alike. Work Environment & Physical Requirements • Standard medical office environment. • Extended periods of computer and phone work. • Occasional reaching, lifting of office materials, and movement throughout the office to support front-desk coverage. description: READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. This post is direct on purpose. It saves your time and ours. Applications that ignore the instructions at the bottom will not be replied to. And to be upfront about the process: text answers don't get you hired here. A screen-share does. If you're not willing to show your real work, live, on camera, stop reading now. ABOUT US 1 DASH ( ---------- ) is a US payments and merchant services company with 20+ years in the industry, serving businesses nationwide. Our stance with our customers is simple: "Running a business is hard. Your payments shouldn't be." The software behind that promise is what you'd be building: a payment and invoicing SaaS, an agent dashboard, a mobile app, and internal analysis tools. Our values are simplicity and transparency, in the product and in how we work. That's also why this post is blunt. Small dev team, zero bureaucracy, and the features you ship get used by real businesses to move real money. THE STACK (THIS IS WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY WORK IN) • TypeScript everywhere, strict mode • Frontend: React 18/19, Next.js 15/16, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod • Backend: Node 20, Express APIs • Database: Supabase (Postgres + Auth), Drizzle ORM and Prisma • Mobile: React Native / Expo with NativeWind and Zustand (nice to have, not required) • Integrations: payment processor APIs (Valor, Dejavoo), OpenAI, Resend, webhooks • Testing: Vitest, Playwright, Supertest • Infra: Vercel, Railway, GitHub Actions, pnpm / Turbo monorepo You do not need every item on this list. You do need to be genuinely strong in TypeScript, React, Node/Express, and SQL/Postgres. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Build features end-to-end: database schema, API endpoint, UI • Fix bugs without being babysat • Write typed, Zod-validated code that passes lint, typecheck, and tests before you say "done" • Work with payment APIs and webhooks. This is fintech, correctness matters more than speed. • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) daily. We expect this. We don't care that you use AI, every good dev does now. We care whether you understand what it produces, and we will verify that live. WHO THIS IS FOR • Mid to senior level: around 3-5+ years of real, shipped work • You can take a loosely defined task and come back with a working, tested feature • You communicate proactively. Blocked means you communicate the same day, not three days later. • You use AI tools heavily however, you can read, verify, and fix everything they produce. If you cannot explain your own code line-by-line on a call, please do not apply. You will be asked to. Please DO NOT APPLY IF • You're an agency or you plan to subcontract the work • You need step-by-step instructions for every task • You cannot explain code you've submitted without an AI tool open • You will not record a Loom video or join a live screen-share call PAY AND SCHEDULE • $10 per hour. This is the rate. • Part-time, around 20 hours per week to start. Can grow into more (and full-time) if you're good. • Flexible schedule, long-term role. THE HIRING PROCESS (SO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR) 1. Application (instructions below) 2. 15-minute live screen-share call. You'll open your own code from the project in your Loom, and I'll ask you to walk through specific files, explain decisions, and reason through a change on the spot. I'll also show you a small snippet from your codebase and ask what it does and what's wrong with it. No prep needed if the work is actually yours. Note on the call: AI tools must be closed during it. Not because we're anti-AI (you'll use Claude Code daily here) but because the call tests the one thing AI can't do for you: understanding. HOW TO APPLY. FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY Read carefully, because the first instruction is not where you expect it. Somewhere in this paragraph is your first filter: the first line of your application must be the word SHIPIT followed by the name of the database from our stack list above. Applications missing either are deleted unread. If you pasted this post into an AI tool and skimmed its summary, you've probably already failed. 1. Attach your resume, or include a Google Drive link set to "anyone with the link can view". A locked link counts as no resume. 2. Record a Loom video, 3-5 minutes. This is the core of your application. Requirements: o Introduce yourself briefly on camera (face visible at the start) o Say today's date and the word from your application's first line out loud o Walk through ONE project you built. Show the actual code in your editor or the live app. No slideshows, no reading from a script. o Open the git history or git blame on at least one file and show your commits o Explain one hard problem you solved AND one design decision you'd make differently today o Videos showing tutorial projects, cloned repos, or code you can't git-blame to yourself are an instant rejection 3. Answer ALL of the questions below, numbered. Skipped questions = deleted application. Keep answers SHORT, 2-3 sentences each. We can tell the difference between concise-because-you-know and long-because-AI-padded. QUESTIONS: EXPERIENCE (links over stories, everything you claim should be checkable) 1. Years of professional experience, and the biggest thing you've shipped that is live right now. A link is required: live URL, App Store listing, or public repo. "I can't link anything" needs a one-sentence explanation (NDA, internal tool, etc.) plus the closest verifiable substitute. 2. Rate yourself 1-10 on each (be honest, the live call and test task will verify): TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node/Express, Postgres/SQL, Supabase. 3. One feature you built end-to-end, database to API to UI. Link the live feature, repo, or PR/commit range, and tell me which parts you personally wrote. 4. Have you worked with payments, fintech, or third-party API webhooks? One concrete example with specifics (which processor/API, what you handled). 5. GitHub or portfolio link. If your GitHub is empty, link whatever you HAVE built instead. QUESTIONS: AI WORKFLOW 6. Which AI coding tools do you use daily and for how long? Then in 2-3 sentences: your last real task with one, what it got wrong, and what you fixed manually. (This gets verified on the call, so be accurate, not impressive.) QUESTIONS: AVAILABILITY 7. How many hours per week are you actually available, and in what timezone? Generic copy-paste cover letters will be deleted. AI-polished applications might slip past me here, but they do not survive the screen-share, so you're only wasting your own time. Only shortlisted applicants will hear back from us. If you followed everything above, you are already ahead of 90% of applicants.

title: Graphic Design & Creative specialist
description: Do you live at the intersection of design and technology? Are you someone who wakes up genuinely excited about what AI can do for creative work — and then actually goes and builds it? About Swerv Digital: Swerv Digital is a performance marketing agency based in Aarhus, Denmark. We are a small, tight-knit team — Viktor, Frederik, and RJ — and we are looking for someone who will not just fill a role, but genuinely become part of the team for the long haul. Our biggest strength is flexibility. We move fast, constantly test new AI models, and adapt the way we work as better tools emerge. We do not hold on to old processes for the sake of comfort. If something better comes along, we adopt it. Our most-used AI tools right now are Manus, Claude, and Lovable — and that list will keep growing. We work with ambitious e-commerce and service businesses, helping them scale through sharp strategy and high-quality execution. Design and creative output is a critical part of that — and that is where you come in. The Role: This is a creative role with a strong AI-forward focus. You will be responsible for producing ad creatives across multiple clients, building and maintaining our graphic design system, creating website mockups, and — most importantly — helping us build a creative AI hub that allows us to produce high volumes of quality content efficiently and consistently. This is also a role where you will learn a lot. The way we work changes constantly because AI keeps getting better, and you will be at the centre of that evolution. If you enjoy figuring things out, building new workflows, and pushing the boundaries of what is possible with the tools available, you will thrive here. Key Responsibilities: Ad Creative Production: Design and deliver high-converting ad creatives for multiple e-commerce clients simultaneously. You will work across formats — static, video-first concepts, carousels, and UGC-style content — maintaining quality and brand consistency at speed. Creative AI Hub Development: Take the lead on building a scalable creative AI system that enables the team to produce high volumes of creatives efficiently. This includes setting up AI-assisted workflows, prompt libraries, template systems, and production pipelines using tools like Claude, Manus, Lovable, and others as they emerge. Graphic Design System: Help build and maintain Swerv Digital's internal design system — including templates, brand guidelines for clients, and reusable asset libraries that make creative production faster and more consistent across the board. Website Mockups & Visual Concepts: Create clear, compelling website mockups and visual concepts for clients, communicating design direction before development begins. Tool Exploration & Adoption: Actively test new AI design tools and models as they emerge. You bring a genuine curiosity and a practical ability to evaluate what is worth adopting and what is noise. Requirements: Strong Graphic Design Skills: You have a solid foundation in graphic design — composition, typography, colour, and visual hierarchy. You can produce polished, professional work independently without needing heavy direction. AI-First Creative Mindset: You are not just aware of AI tools — you use them daily, build with them, and think creatively about how to leverage them to produce better work faster. Experience with Claude, Canva AI, Midjourney, or similar tools is a strong advantage. Design Tool Proficiency: You are comfortable working in tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro), and Canva. You do not need to be a master of all of them, but you need to be functional across the stack. Ad Creative Experience: You understand what makes an ad perform. You have experience designing creatives for paid social — particularly Meta — and you know the difference between beautiful design and design that converts. Strong English: You must be highly proficient in written and spoken English. Our team communicates in English, our clients operate across markets, and the quality of your written communication matters. Proactive & Creative Thinker: You do not wait to be told what to do. You spot gaps, propose ideas, and bring energy to the work. In a team of three, initiative is not optional — it is essential. Team Fit: We are a small, international team and we are looking for someone who wants to grow with us over years, not months. RJ, one of our core tea ---------- mbers, is Filipino, and we value a team culture that is open, direct, and genuinely collaborative. Cultural fit matters as much as skill. Nice to Have: Video Editing: If you have experience editing short-form video content — whether for paid ads, social media, or client campaigns — that is a significant bonus. We produce video content for clients and having someone who can cut, pace, and polish footage (in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar) means you can contribute across the full creative stack. It is not a requirement, but it will make you stand out. Why Join Swerv Digital? At Swerv Digital, you will not be one of twenty designers in a department. You will be the creative voice of a fast-moving agency, with direct influence over how we work and what we produce. You will work closely with Viktor, Frederik, and RJ on real client accounts, with real budgets, and see the direct impact of your work. You will be at the forefront of AI-driven creative production — not reading about it in newsletters, but actually building it. We invest in our team's development and create space for continuous learning, because the better you get, the better we all get. If you are someone who is energized by change, loves building things, and wants to be part of a team that genuinely cares about doing great work — this is the place for you. How to Apply Send your portfolio, a short introduction about yourself, and any examples of graphic design, AI-assisted creative work and video editing you have done. title: Assistant Buyer (Data & Procurement Specialist)
description: We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and fast-paced Assistant Buyer to join our procurement team. In this role, you will be the backbone of our data management, responsible for processing large volumes of supplier sheets on a daily basis. Your primary focus will be to clean, match, and analyze supplier data to ensure accurate purchasing alignment and to heavily prepare our team for vendor negotiations. If you thrive in a rapid-fire, high-volume environment and consider yourself an Excel/Google Sheets wizard who can turn chaotic data into actionable insights instantly, we want to hear from you. Key Responsibilities Data Matching & Analysis: Review and reconcile massive daily supplier sheets against our current purchasing needs and active inventory. Negotiation Preparation: Build comparative data models and cost-analysis sheets to provide the buying team with leverage and clear metrics prior to supplier negotiations. Data Integration: Clean, format, and organize incoming vendor data, ensuring seamless integration into our internal systems. Discrepancy Resolution: Quickly identify and flag pricing anomalies, SKU mismatches, or supply gaps. Pipeline Speed: Maintain a high daily output of processed sheets to keep pace with our fast-moving procurement cycle. Required Skills & Qualifications Advanced Excel & Google Sheets Expertise: You must be highly proficient with advanced formulas, including VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, IF/IFS statements, and data nesting. Speed and Efficiency: Proven ability to manipulate and audit thousands of rows of data rapidly without sacrificing accuracy. Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot trends, pricing discrepancies, and data patterns quickly. Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-pressure environment where priorities can shift daily. Communication: Ability to clearly present data findings and summaries to the lead buyers. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience in procurement, supply chain, e-commerce, or retail buying. Familiarity with inventory management software or ERP systems. Experience writing basic macros or utilizing Google Apps Script is a plus. How to Apply Please submit your resume along with a brief note highlighting your specific experience managing large-scale data sets using Excel or Google Sheets. Note: A brief practical spreadsheet assessment may be required as part of the interview process.

Optimizing existing website pages for better rankings, higher CTR, better internal linking, stronger topical relevance, and improved conversions. Working with writers, designers, developers, and marketing managers to make sure SEO recommendations are actually implemented correctly. Improving website structure, URL architecture, navigation, schema markup, internal linking, and crawl depth. Monitoring Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs/Semrush, Screaming Frog, and other SEO tools to find issues and opportunities. Creating monthly SEO reports that explain what changed, what improved, what declined, why it happened, and what we should do next. Identifying and fixing indexing problems, duplicate content, cannibalization, thin content, broken links, redirect issues, sitemap problems, robots.txt issues, and technical bottlenecks. Building local SEO strategies, including Google Business Profile optimization, local landing pages, citations, reviews, and location-based keyword targeting. Helping develop backlink and digital PR strategies when needed, including outreach targets, linkable assets, guest post opportunities, and brand mentions. Using AI tools intelligently for research, outlines, briefs, clustering, optimization, and analysis — but not blindly publishing generic AI content like a content farm from 2013. Required Skills You must have strong experience with: Google Search Console Google Analytics / GA4 Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar SEO tools Screaming Frog or Sitebulb WordPress SEO Technical SEO On-page SEO Keyword research Content strategy Competitor analysis Internal linking strategy Local SEO SEO reporting Basic HTML/CSS understanding Schema markup basics Page speed and Core Web Vitals basics Experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, Webflow, or custom CMS platforms is a strong plus. What We Are Looking For We want someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, and strategic. You should be the kind of person who does not just say, “traffic dropped.” You should be able to investigate and say: “Traffic dropped because these 4 pages lost rankings after a competitor expanded their topical coverage, our internal links are weak, and Google is now favoring pages with stronger commercial intent. Here’s what we should do.” That is the level we are looking for. You should also be comfortable challenging ideas. If a client, writer, or manager suggests something that does not make sense for SEO, we expect you to explain the better approach clearly and professionally. Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with SEO for service businesses Experience with e-commerce SEO Experience with local SEO for multi-location businesses Experience building topical maps Experience with programmatic SEO Experience with conversion rate optimization Experience using Make, Zapier, Airtable, or Google Sheets for SEO workflows Experience creating content briefs for writers Experience managing SEO projects in ClickUp, Asana, Trello, Monday, or similar tools Work Style This is a remote position. We need someone who understands that SEO is not just about rankings — it is about bringing the right traffic that can turn into leads, sales, and revenue. job_title: Ecommerce Growth Operator | Supplement Brand | TikTok Research and Meta Ads
description: **Ecommerce Growth Operator | Supplement Brand | TikTok Research and Meta Ads** --- We are building a supplement brand from the ground up. The model is simple. We find supplement products that are already proven on TikTok Shop, private label our own version, build a Shopify store around it, and scale it with Meta ads. We move fast, we test fast, and we double down on what works. We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who understands this model, has done something like it before, and can take a product from research to live store to running ads without needing their hand held every step of the way. --- **What this role actually looks like** You will spend time researching supplement products that are already selling well on TikTok Shop. You are looking for products with strong demand signals, real social proof, good margins, and room to compete with a private label version. Once you identify a winner you will help us source a private label version, work with our supplier to get it produced or fulfilled, and build a Shopify store around it that is clean, trustworthy, and built to convert. Then you launch Meta ads. You find the best performing videos for that product or category, make them better, write the copy, set up the campaigns, and monitor performance daily. You cut what is not working and push harder on what is converting. You understand that in the supplement space trust and credibility are everything so the store, the ads, and the messaging all need to feel legitimate and professional. You will also handle supplier communication, verify orders, coordinate fulfillment, and keep operations organized as we scale. --- **The supplement space has specific requirements and you need to understand them** Supplement ads on Meta have strict rules. You cannot make certain health claims. You cannot use before and after imagery in certain ways. You need to know what gets ads disapproved and how to write copy that converts without triggering a policy violation. If you have never run supplement ads before this is not the role for you. If you have and you know how to navigate the compliance side while still writing ads that sell this is exactly the role for you. The same applies to the store. A supplement store needs to feel credible. That means professional product photography or AI generated imagery that looks real, clear ingredient information, trust signals like reviews and guarantees, and copy that speaks to real customer concerns without making illegal claims. --- **Who we are looking for** You have researched winning products on TikTok Shop before and you can walk us through your process. You have run Meta ads for a physical product brand and you have real numbers to show for it. You understand the supplement space well enough to know what sells, what claims are allowed, and how to position a private label product against established brands. You can build a Shopify store from scratch in under 8 hours. You are comfortable sourcing private label products and communicating with suppliers. You use AI tools every day to speed up research, copy, and creative production. You work independently and you are focused on results not just completing tasks. --- **You are not the right fit if** You have never run a paid ad campaign from scratch. You do not understand supplement compliance on Meta. You need a team around you to do product research. You cannot show us proof of something you tested and what happened. You are looking for a slow paced admin role. --- **Experience that will move you to the top of the list** You have run Meta ads specifically for a supplement or health and wellness brand. You have private labeled a product before and understand the sourcing and fulfillment process. You have used Kalodata or a similar tool for TikTok product research. You have experience with supplement compliance on Meta and know how to write copy that converts without violating policies. You have built a Shopify store for a health or wellness brand that felt credible and professional. --- **Tools you should know** Kalodata for TikTok product research and validation. Shopify for store builds and product management. Meta Business Manager for campaign setup and management. CapCut or any video editor for creative production. Claude, ChatGPT or any AI tool for copy, research, and workflow. Triple Whale or any attribution and tracking tool is a strong plus. Canva or Photoshop for basic image editing and visual work. --- **How we structure pay** Base hourly rate plus a performance percentage tied to sales you directly generate. If you find winners and scale them your earnings grow with the results. We start with a short trial period so both sides can see if this works before committing long term. --- **How to apply** We want proof not promises. Tell us about a product you researched and tested. What was it, how did you find it, and what happened with the numbers. Tell us about any supplement or health brand experience you have. Share any Meta ad results you have even rough numbers are fine. Tell us your product research process step by step. Tell us which tools you use and why. If you have private labeled a product before tell us about that specifically. Generic applications will not be considered. Specific ones with real examples and real numbers will get a fast response.

Things that should be simple, like notifying clients before a visit or following up on an overdue balance, are slipping through the cracks because there aren’t enough hours in the day. Your first big win is to take ownership of that chain: getting work scheduled and clients notified, making sure invoices go out on time, and chasing down the receivables that are sitting unpaid. Done well, this one thing brings order to the busiest part of our operation and frees Ken to focus on growth instead of firefighting. The full scope of the role: This is a true right-hand role. Over time, you’ll own a wide range of the work that keeps the business running, organized into three areas. Scheduling & client communication • Plant Health Care (PHC) scheduling and client notifications — getting visits on the calendar and making sure clients know we’re coming • Maintenance scheduling — keeping recurring service on track • Reschedules and cancellations — handling changes quickly and keeping the calendar accurate • New lead communication through Certified Lead Kings (CLK) and Google— staying on top of email and text with clients • Quality assurance — calling clients after service to check in and make sure they’re happy Billing, collections & renewals • Accounts receivable — sending invoices promptly and keeping receivables current • Accounts payable — keeping bills and vendor payments organized • Collections — following up on overdue balances with a consistent, friendly cadence until they’re paid • Renewals — working expiring contracts and recurring services before they lapse Operations & data • Data entry — keeping customer and job records clean and accurate, reconciling transactions in Quickbooks • New employee file onboarding — setting up paperwork and records as we add to the team Who we’re looking for • 3+ years of administrative or VA experience, preferably with US-based small businesses • Genuinely detail-oriented. You catch the things that slip past other people. This is the single most important trait for this role. • Native-equivalent spoken English. You’ll be on the phone with US homeowners regularly, and we want them to feel like they’re talking to a member of our team. • Proactive and a self-starter. You see problems and bring solutions. We don’t want to micromanage you, and you’ll thrive here if you’d rather take initiative than wait for instructions. • Warm and client-facing. Our clients trust us with their homes and their land — they should feel that warmth in every interaction with you. • Comfortable in, or willing to learn quickly: SingleOps, QuickBooks, Certified Lead Kings, and Google Workspace • Tree-care experience is not required — we’ll teach you everything you need to know about our world What we offer • Full-time, 40 hours per week, US business hours. We know this is a big ask, and we’ll respect your time and pay accordingly. • Competitive monthly pay based on your experience • 13th-month pay • Paid Philippine holidays • Annual performance reviews with real raises for great work • A long-term home. We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for our right hand — someone who becomes indispensable to how Ken operates. As we grow, your role and your pay will grow with us. job_title: All-round Digital Growth Marketer: property tech plus a new SaaS, remote
description: All-round Digital Growth Marketer: property tech plus a new SaaS, remote The short version We are a European property-tech group and we need someone who can build our growth across the board. Not one channel, the whole picture: SEO and content, paid, social, AI search, influencers, email , and new international channels. You can do a bit of all of it, you go deep where it counts, and you love finding new ways to reach people. If you can prove what you have grown, read on. Who we are We run several live rental platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, including an established rental and property-management brand and a more modern consumer rental platform. The rental platforms are where most of our volume is today. On top of that we are launching a new in-house SaaS product in the hiring and recruitment space, which you help grow from the start. So you get both: established brands with real traffic, and a new product where you shape growth from day one. How we work Small team, fast pace, real ownership. We care about clear communication, good decisions, and results we can measure. We use AI tools to move faster and we expect you to do the same, as long as you check and refine before anything ships. We work async and in writing. Your first days 1. Get our analytics and conversion tracking in solid shape, so we can actually see what works. 2. Find the quickest wins across the channels we already have, and start improving them. 3. Run the first acquisition experiments for the new SaaS product. From there you open it up: SEO and content, paid, email and lifecycle, social, AI search visibility, influencers, and international channels. We want someone who keeps finding new ways in, not just running the obvious ones. What you will own over time - The full growth picture across the rental platforms and the new SaaS: which channels we use, what we test next, and what actually moves the numbers. - SEO and content (NL and EN): search, on-page, listings, and content that ranks and converts. - Getting us visible where people actually look now, including AI search results and answer engines, not just Google. - Paid where it earns its place (Google, Meta), plus email and lifecycle automation. - Social, brand, influencer and creative channel experiments, including international audiences. - Analytics and simple conversion improvements on listing and signup pages, with clear reporting. What we are looking for - Real digital marketing experience with results you can explain, in numbers. - Broadly skilled: comfortable across SEO, content, paid, social, email and analytics, and able to go deep where it matters. - A channel explorer: you have opened up or tested channels beyond the obvious ones and can show it. - Strong written English. Dutch is a strong advantage. If you do not write Dutch, you must be comfortable managing translation and native review. - Self-managing, reliable, and good at written async communication. - Ideally 6 hours overlap with CET business hours, Monday to Friday. Tell us your timezone and the window you can cover. Nice to have - Property, real estate, or marketplace marketing. - SaaS or early-stage product growth. - Marketing automation or CRM, landing-page and conversion work, light design. Rate and hours USD per hour depending on your experience. Part-time to full-time, ideally 20 or more hours a week to start. This is a long-term role: strong work and real results move both your scope and your rate up over time and grow with results. How we start (paid) We begin with a small paid, time-boxed task we agree upfront, to see how you analyze, prioritize and execute on something real. No unpaid speculative campaign work, ever. If it clicks, we move into the ongoing role. How to apply (English, no template letters) Start the first line of your reply with: Growth that ships. Then tell us: 1. One channel you grew, with the actual result (numbers, before and after). 2. A channel or tactic you tried that most people would not think of, and how it went. 3. How you use AI tools in your work, and how you keep quality in check. 4. The two or three channels you are strongest in, and where you are still growing. 5. A link to your portfolio or one thing you are proud of. 6. Your hourly rate in USD, hours per day you can commit, your CET overlap window, and your earliest start date. Do not apply if - You are not the person who will do the work. - You cannot show or explain real results. - You only run one channel and do not want to work across the rest. - You ship AI-generated content without checking it. Skill requirement: Digital Marketing, SEO, Content Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Analytics Employer: M. Oosterom

You understand campaign structure, ad sets, audiences, creative testing, and how to read the numbers. You know what a winning creative looks like and you know how to find or build one. You know how Google Shopping works and you have set up or managed Performance Max or standard Shopping campaigns before. You understand funnels. You know that the ad is only one part of the equation and that the landing page, the offer, and the follow up all matter. You are comfortable setting up or improving landing pages to support your campaigns. You are organized and you report clearly. We need to know what is working, what is not, and what you are doing about it. --- **Experience that will move you to the top of the list** You have managed a monthly ad budget of at least five thousand dollars across Meta or Google. Any landing page builder — GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Unbounce, Shopify pages, or similar. Canva or any basic design tool for simple creative edits. Claude, ChatGPT or any AI tool for copy and research. Spreadsheets for reporting and budget tracking. --- **How we work** This is a full time role. You will manage ad accounts across both businesses and report directly to the owner. We expect clear communication, proactive updates, and a mindset focused on results not just activity. We do not want someone who runs ads and waits to be told what to fix. We want someone who sees a problem and fixes it before we even notice it. --- **How to apply** Show us real results. Tell us about any experience running ads for service businesses, hospitality, or bookings. Share any landing pages you have built or improved. Tell us your monthly ad spend experience.
