description: **Shopify Store Builder and Product Listing Manager | GMC Approval and Ongoing Catalog Management** --- We are launching a new ecommerce store and we need someone who can build it the right way from the start. Not just a good looking store but one that is structured correctly to get approved by Google Merchant Center so we can start selling through Google Shopping. Once the store is live and approved the role shifts into ongoing catalog management where you will be adding products and keeping everything accurate and up to date every single day. This is a long term full time role. The right person will own this store from build to approval to daily operations. --- **Phase one — Building the store** You will build our Shopify store from scratch. That means setting up the theme, homepage, collections, navigation, product pages, and all the essential pages like about, contact, refund policy, privacy policy, and terms of service. Everything needs to be clean, mobile friendly, and on brand for a home decor audience. More importantly everything needs to be structured correctly for Google Merchant Center from day one. That means accurate product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, GTINs, and all required attributes. Shipping and return policies need to meet GMC requirements. The store needs to pass GMC review without issues. You will also set up the Google Merchant Center account, connect it to Shopify, configure the product feed, and make sure everything syncs correctly and cleanly. --- **Phase two — Ongoing catalog management** Once the store is live and GMC approved the role becomes about keeping the catalog growing and accurate. You will be adding new products regularly, updating existing listings, maintaining image quality, and making sure nothing falls out of GMC compliance over time. We expect around 50 products processed within a 2.5 hour window at a consistently high standard. You will also build out new collection pages and theme sections as the catalog grows, run regular audits to catch errors or disapprovals before they become problems, and keep inventory levels accurate and organized. --- **What we need from you** You have built a Shopify store from scratch before and you understand what it takes to get it right the first time. You know Google Merchant Center inside and out. You know what causes disapprovals, how to fix them, and how to structure a store so it passes review cleanly. You are fast and accurate with product listings. Speed without accuracy does not work in this role. You have a strong eye for visual detail. You care about how the store looks and you can tell when something feels off brand. You use AI tools like Gemini and ChatGPT daily to speed up your workflow without sacrificing quality. You can work independently once you understand our standards. --- **Experience that will move you to the top of the list** You have successfully gotten a Shopify store approved on Google Merchant Center before. You have managed a large product catalog with hundreds of SKUs. You have experience using Gemini specifically for generating product images that feel consistent and branded rather than generic or stock looking. You have used Kopy or a similar tool for writing and optimizing product listings. Home decor, beauty, health, or lifestyle brand experience is a strong plus. --- **Tools you should know or be ready to learn fast** Shopify for store builds and product management. Google Merchant Center for feed setup, compliance, and account management. Gemini for AI product image generation. Kopy or similar for listing copy and optimization. ChatGPT or any AI tool for descriptions and workflow. Canva or Photoshop for image editing and visual cleanup. --- **How we work** We will onboard you into our brand standards, product requirements, and what good looks like for us. After that you own the store completely from the technical setup to the daily listing work. We have high standards but we do not micromanage. We expect clean work, consistent output, and clear communication. --- **How to apply** Tell us about a Shopify store you built from scratch. If you have gotten a store approved on Google Merchant Center tell us about that specifically — what you set up, what issues came up, and how you resolved them. Share examples of product listings you have created or optimized. Tell us how many products you can list per hour at a high standard. Tell us which AI tools you use and how you use them. If you have used Gemini for product image generation tell us about that. Generic applications will not be considered. Specific ones with real examples will get a fast response.

description: A growing multi-doctor dental practice is seeking an experienced Dental Insurance & Treatment Plan Financial Coordinator to support an increasing volume of complex treatment cases. Their role is to accurately determine insurance coverage, estimate patient responsibility, identify non-covered services, and prepare documentation needed for financial consultations and treatment approval. Presentation of Treatment Plans The primary responsibility of this role is to prepare complete financial and insurance packages for dentist-approved treatment plans. In most cases, these materials will be provided to the in-office team, who will conduct the financial consultation with the patient. Depending on the practice's workflow and the candidate's experience, there may be opportunities to assist with remote patient consultations, including reviewing treatment costs, insurance coverage, and available financing options. title: Web Developer + Graphic Designer
description: WHO WE ARE We’re not a typical health clinic. Averus Group operates two health and wellness brands  (Cerebral Health and Magnolia Hyperbarics) delivering advanced neurological and physical treatments including PEMF, HBOT, and neurological rehabilitation. Our patients come to us when conventional medicine hasn’t worked. We get results because we hold ourselves to an exceptional standard across every function of the business — including marketing. We’re building an in-house team that owns outcomes, not just outputs. That means the people we hire aren’t task-completers — they’re operators who understand that the quality of their work directly affects whether a patient walks through our door and gets the help they need. THE ROLE Build what patients see first– and make it impossible to ignore. This is a combined role for someone who is equally strong in web development and graphic design. You’ll maintain and improve the Cerebral Health and Magnolia Hyperbarics websites, build CRO-focused landing pages for paid campaigns, and create every visual asset that represents both brands — from ad creatives to social graphics to in-clinic materials. You work from the Content Playbook brand guide and are accountable for brand consistency across every touchpoint. This isn’t a role for someone who likes to take their time on perfect pieces. It’s a production role — fast output, consistent quality, zero off-brand assets reaching the public. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Day-to-day, here's what this looks like. Website & Landing Pages • Maintain and update ---------- and the Magnolia Hyperbarics website — service pages, blog templates, speed optimization. • Build and iterate CRO-focused landing pages for paid campaigns — starting with LP7 (concussion) and future variants. • Install and monitor heatmaps (Hotjar or equivalent) on key pages — report findings monthly. • Ensure Core Web Vitals and page speed scores remain in the green range. • Implement on-page SEO recommendations from the SEO Specialist — meta titles, schema, internal links. Graphic Design & Visual Assets • Create all social graphics, Instagram carousels, story templates, and Facebook post visuals for both brands. • Design ad creatives in multiple formats — static and animated — for Meta and Google campaigns. • Build and maintain a branded template library so recurring content formats can be produced quickly. • Create email imagery and HTML email layouts in coordination with the CRM Specialist. • Design print and in-clinic materials as needed — brochures, signage, patient handouts. • All output must comply with the Content Playbook brand guide — color palette, typography, voice attributes. Brand Compliance • Review all team-produced visual content against the brand guide before publishing. • Flag deviations to the Marketing Manager — do not let off-brand content reach the public. • Maintain a Canva brand kit with all approved fonts, colors, logos, and templates. YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF... Two disciplines. One person. Both at a high level. • You build pages, not just mockups You can open WordPress and ship a page without handing it off to a developer. You understand CRO basics, page speed, and why a landing page that looks good but loads slowly is a problem. • You can deliver a finished creative by tomorrow 24–48 hour turnaround isn’t a stretch goal — it’s the baseline. You’re fast, organized, and your output is polished under pressure. • You design to the brief, not to your taste Brand discipline means the guide is the rule. You don’t freelance the color palette or swap the font because it looks better to you. You ask on day one, and you flag when something is off. • You understand what healthcare content can and can’t say You know how regulated industries work visually and verbally. You don’t need to learn on the job what language or imagery will get a post flagged or a page penalized. • You’re strong in both web and design — not just one This is a combined role by design. If you’re a great designer who can’t touch a WordPress page — or a solid developer who produces flat, unpolished visuals — we’ll hire those functions separately. WHAT YOU'LL GET We take care of the people who take care of our patients. • Paid Time Off — Recharge so you can perform at your best. We respect the time you take away from work. • Sick Days — When life happens, it happens. Take the time you need to recover without the pressure. • Fully Remote — Work remote with a team spread across time zones — autonomy and flexibility built in. • Real Growth — This is a growing organization. As both brands scale, so do the opportunities for the people building them. • A Team That Cares — We hire people who are bought into the mission. You'll work alongside others who understand why the work matters, not just what the work is. • A Greater Mission — Every qualified booking you drive is a patient who gets access to treatment that could change their life. That's not marketing copy — that's the reality of what we do. Ready to apply? Send us 5+ social or ad creative samples, at least one landing page you designed and built, and a brief description of the last brand guide you worked with. Show us your web work and your design work — both matter equally here.

title: ADVICE ASSOCIATE  (URGENT - FINANCIAL ADVICE EXPERIENCE )
description: ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY (APPLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE) Location: Remote Type: Full-time Salary: AUD$10-$15ph ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives. ABOUT THE ROLE The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team. FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES 1. The Information Steward - Custodian of all essential client information and access rights. - Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc. - Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements). - Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times. - Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence. - Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly. - Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms. - Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management. - Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?” 2. The Delivery Project Manager - Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines. - Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval. - Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks. - Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution. - Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome. - Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals. - Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties. - Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?” 3. The Relationship Anchor - Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client. - Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly. - Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients. - Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life. - Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings. - Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal. - Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting. - Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates. - Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?” 4. The Compliant Storyteller - Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story. - Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes. - Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up email s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information. - Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised. - Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions. - Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals. - Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered. - Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?” PRIORITISATION ORDER - From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order: - Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction. - Insurance applications and getting policies into force. - Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting email s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser. - Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour). - Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding). - Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc). - Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority. - Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task. REPORTING & COLLABORATION Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes. Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser. Indicators of Success - 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access. - Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention. - High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients. - Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work. - Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio. - Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours. - Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms. Expected Behaviour - Proactive, reliable, and accountable. - Thoughtful and detail-oriented. - Able to prioritise and escalate as needed. - Collaborative, not siloed. - Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency. APPLICATION PROCESS To apply, please submit the following: • A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are the best fit for this role • Your updated CV and LinkedIn profile link • Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal) Please apply and email all details to: ---------- ONLY those who follow the instructions in how to apply will be accommodated.

job_title: Short-Form and Long-Form Video Editor — Instagram & YouTube (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description: Hi — I’m Siobhan, founder of Envision Coaching, a women’s coaching business based in the UK. We work with women to help them permanently transform their bodies, build their confidence, and make incredible change in all areas of life. I’m looking for a skilled, reliable video editor to join the team on a part-time, long-term basis. This is a role for someone who takes pride in their work, communicates well, and can deliver consistently without constant supervision. THE CONTENT You’ll be editing both short-form and long-form content. Short-form content is primarily purposed for Instagram Reels featuring me, my coaching team, clients, and events. The content typically comprises the following: Talking-head style – Think: punchy hooks, tight cuts, on-screen captions, and editing that keeps viewers watching. This is personal brand and coaching content, not corporate or generic. Since raw content is performing well right now, we are not looking for flashy effects — we are looking for clean, intentional editing that serves the message. Almost like I could have edited it myself. “Kitchen” reels – Me talking to camera, similar to the above but often using props. This content is typically more educational. Promotional content – Typically to promote events that we hold periodically throughout the year. This might be a highlight of an event or photoshoot, or an announcement reel for a speaker at an upcoming event, for example. Client interviews – Raw recordings from Zoom will be provided. It will be your job to edit the long-form version for trainings and YouTube, and take soundbites for short-form content on Instagram. Other long-form content – VSLs for sales pages, training video edits, and occasional YouTube videos. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING - Editing raw talking-head footage into polished Instagram Reels (typically 30–90 seconds) - Editing long-form Zoom recordings into clean training videos and YouTube content - Pulling soundbites from long-form interviews for short-form Instagram use - Editing VSLs, promotional content, and event highlight reels - Adding on-screen captions/subtitles — accurate, well-styled, and on-brand - Trimming for pace and retention — tight edits, no dead air - Adding simple B-roll, transitions, or text overlays where appropriate - Receiving raw footage and a brief via Google Drive and returning edited files to the same location - Meeting agreed turnaround times consistently - Communicating proactively if anything is unclear or delayed WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience editing both short-form content for Instagram or TikTok and long-form content for YouTube or similar platforms - Strong understanding of retention-based editing — hooks, pacing, captioning - Experience editing Zoom recordings or interview-style footage - Proficient in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar editing software - title: Project / Studio Manager (Design Agency)
description: Anyday is a product-design subscription studio. Funded startups and scaling teams pay us a flat monthly fee and get a senior design team on tap — no scoping wars, no per-project haggling, no hiring a $300k Head of Design. We design the products people actually use: fintech apps, banking flows, payments platforms, SaaS tools. We're small, fast, and profitable. What we do - Product design — app and web-app UI/UX for funded startups. - Brand & web — identity systems and marketing sites alongside the product work. - AI & automation — workflow audits and AI-assisted tools built into client products and our own ops. We deliver through a small bench of senior designers, a fractional Head of Design (our founder), and tight, AI-augmented operations. You'd be the person who keeps that machine humming. Why this role matters Right now the founder is the bottleneck — he sells, designs, and runs every project. The studio is growing faster than one person can traffic. This role takes the entire delivery engine off his plate. That means you're not a note-taker or a status-chaser. You run the studio floor. You decide who works on what, you protect the client relationship, and you're the reason a client opens Slack on Monday already knowing exactly where their project stands. Get this right and you become the operational backbone of a studio that's about to scale across multiple brands — with the autonomy and ownership that comes with being early. We lean hard on AI to do this well. If you already use AI to summarise calls, draft status updates, triage requests, and move faster than a "normal" PM - you'll feel at home and you'll have room to build the system further. What you'll do - Traffic the studio — assign and balance design work across clients and designers so nothing slips and no one's overloaded. - Own client communication — run a weekly Monday status update for every active client so they always know what's shipping, what's next, and what you need from them. Kill the mid-week "any update?" pings before they happen. - Drive projects to done — track every deliverable in ClickUp against quoted scope; flag risks early; keep delivery on time and on brief. - Guard profitability — track logged hours against quoted scope and surface overruns before they eat margin. - Onboard new clients — set expectations, stand up channels, and get the first deliverable moving cleanly. - Run our ops with AI — use AI tools to summarise calls, draft updates, triage requests, and tighten the delivery system over time. - Keep the pipeline honest — maintain the proposal / project tracker (win rates, follow-ups, engagement) so we learn from every deal. Must-haves - Project / studio / traffic management experience — ideally at a design, creative, or digital agency. - Excellent English communication — you'll be the client's main point of contact, written and on calls. - Genuinely organised — you keep many moving projects clear in your head and in the tools. - Tool fluency — ClickUp (or similar PM tools), Slack, and a real appetite for AI tools to work faster. - Calm under load — comfortable juggling competing priorities without dropping balls. - UAE / GST working-hours overlap for client calls and daily traffic. Nice-to-haves - Design or creative background (you don't design, but you should speak the language). - FinTech / SaaS client exposure. - Experience building or improving delivery systems and SOPs, not just running them. - Comfort being early at a fast-scaling, multi-brand studio. Engagement - Type: Part-time contractor to start, scaling toward full-time as client load grows. - Hours: ~20 hrs/week to begin, flexible. Daily presence matters more than block hours — the studio needs eyes on it every working day. - Reporting: Works directly with the founder (fractional Head of Design); partners closely with the senior designers. - Tools: ClickUp, Slack, Figma (viewing), plus our AI stack.

I consider myself a good writer, and you should  be able to write as well or better than me so you can communicate on my behalf. You’ll be managing my Inbox and replying to email s in my voice. Spoken English: You should be able to converse in English, so that you can participate in phone calls and video meetings. You must have a strong grasp of AI tools and their capabilities. In fact, you should already be using AI tools in your daily life. If we can travel back in time two months, and you were working with me then, here are some actual projects I’d assign to you: We have a series of email campaigns we need to send to our user-base of 1-million+ users. Wait until our content producer is finished with the content, then prep, schedule, and monitor all of the campaigns. Then, reply to everyone that replies to the campaign. Go through the last six months of email s in my Inbox and reply to anyone needing a reply. A big customer has reached out directly to me and they're upset because they feel like the support team hasn't adequately addressed the issue. Dig in, find out what's going on, and solve the issue for the customer. I need to plan an in-person retreat for my small leadership team. We need hotels, flights, dinners, and a space to collaborate. Can you plan it? The lease on my car is ending next month. I would usually lease a new car, but interest rates are higher than they've ever been since I started driving cars. Is leasing or buying the better option now? I’ve d ---------- to buy a baby grand piano for my kids to practice on. Research pianos, stores, and costs, and ultimately tell me what to do. While lots of job ads ask for "a self starter" and "a team player" and "someone that can multitask" and "some with attention to detail" and "someone who's organized", I find all those requirements silly, because everyone in the workforce should have those skills. Those are baseline skills needed to succeed at any job, including this one. It's important to have a good understanding of people and how to make people feel good. Do you know what to say to an angry customer? Can you anticipate what will resolve the situation without the customer explicitly telling you? Finally, it's important that we get along and enjoy working together. If we don't, we'll start to drift, the role will become stagnant, and we’ll eventually part ways. Feel free to start to get to know me from my LinkedIn page. If you're a good candidate for this quirky, unorthodox, but fun role, then I'm looking forward to getting to know you too. title: Remote Medical Scribe / Clinical Documentation Specialist - Pain Management - eCW Preferred
job_title: Remote Medical Scribe / Clinical Documentation Specialist - Pain Management - eCW Preferred
description: Genesis Pain Clinic is a US-based interventional pain management clinic looking for a full-time Remote Medical Scribe / Clinical Documentation Specialist. This is a live, synchronous, camera-on clinical documentation role. This is not a general VA role. This is not an entry-level admin role. This is not asynchronous transcription. This is not just typing after the visit. You will work directly with the physician during real patient encounters and help document clear, accurate, medically appropriate notes inside eClinicalWorks. We are looking for a long-term tea ---------- mber who can become the physician's clinical documentation partner. -------------------------------------------------- SCHEDULE -------------------------------------------------- Monday-Friday 9:00 AM-5:00 PM US Central Time 40 hours per week This is an overnight/graveyard shift in the Philippines. Approximate Philippines schedule: 10:00 PM-6:00 AM during US daylight saving time 11:00 PM-7:00 AM during US standard time Important schedule note: This role requires a stable overnight work routine. Please apply only if you have successfully worked night shift/graveyard shift before, or if you are confident you can maintain this schedule long term. We respect that night work is difficult. Because this role requires significant training, please do not apply if you are actively looking for a daytime job, cannot maintain a night schedule, or expect to leave after a short period. We are looking for someone who can reasonably commit to at least 6 months. A 12-month commitment is preferred. -------------------------------------------------- PAY -------------------------------------------------- $6.50-$8.50 USD per hour depending on verified experience. Higher pay may be considered for a candidate with strong experience in: - Live medical scribing - eClinicalWorks - Pain management - PM&R / orthopedics / spine - Psychiatry or behavioral health documentation - Workers' Compensation evaluations - Independent Medical Evaluations - Prior authorizations - Medical record review Performance review may be considered after 90 days. -------------------------------------------------- ABOUT THE ROLE -------------------------------------------------- You will assist the physician during live patient encounters. Your primary job is to create accurate, organized, medically useful documentation. You will help document: - Chief complaint - History of present illness - Past medical history - Past surgical history - Medication reconciliation - Allergies - Social history when relevant - Review of systems when relevant - Physical exam findings - Imaging and diagnostic history - Prior treatment history - Assessment / medical diagnoses - Treatment plan - Medication plan - Procedure plan - Follow-up plan - Medical necessity support You must be able to listen carefully, understand clinical information, and turn the encounter into a clean note that the physician can quickly review, edit, and sign. -------------------------------------------------- WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR -------------------------------------------------- The ideal candidate may have a background as a: - Experienced medical scribe - Registered Nurse - Physical Therapist - Pharmacist - Physician / medical graduate - Medical Technologist - Healthcare BPO professional with clinical documentation experience - Medical transcriptionist with live scribing experience - Clinical documentation specialist A license is not strictly required. Strong clinical understanding, excellent English, fast typing, accuracy, professionalism, and ability to learn the physician's documentation style are more important than the title alone. -------------------------------------------------- REQUIRED EXPERIENCE -------------------------------------------------- Please apply only if you have most of the following: - At least 1 year of medical scribing or clinical documentation experience - Strong medical terminology - Strong written English - Strong spoken English - Ability to understand fast physician-patient conversations - Ability to document HPI, exam, assessment, and plan - Typing speed of at least 60 WPM preferred - Comfortable working live during patient visits - Comfortable being on camera during clinical encounters - Comfortable using templates, macros, favorites, and structured notes - Strong computer skills - Ability to use dual monitors - Ability to navigate multiple tabs and systems at the same time - Reliable wired internet - Backup internet - Backup power source - Quiet private workspace - HIPAA-level confidentiality -------------------------------------------------- STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE -------------------------------------------------- Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in: - eClinicalWorks - Pain management - PM&R - Orthopedics - Spine care - Neurology - Psychiatry or behavioral health - Medication reconciliation - Prior authorizations - Medical necessity documentation - Workers' Compensation evaluations - Independent Medical Evaluations - Personal injury documentation - Medical record summaries - Imaging review summaries - Procedure documentation - Template creation or template modification -------------------------------------------------- PAIN MANAGEMENT DOCUMENTATION -------------------------------------------------- Pain management experience is a major advantage. You should be comfortable learning or documenting issues such as: - Neck pain - Low back pain - Radiculopathy - Spinal stenosis - Facet-mediated pain - Sacroiliac joint pain - Joint pain - Myofascial pain - Neuropathy - Fibromyalgia - CRPS - Headache / migraine - Chronic pain medication management - Opioid risk documentation - Failed conservative care - Physical therapy history - Imaging correlation - Functional limitations - Prior injections and response - Medical necessity for procedures Examples of procedures we perform or discuss may include: - Epidural steroid injections - Medial branch blocks - Radiofrequency ablation - SI joint injections - Trigger point injections - Large joint injections - Ultrasound-guided procedures - Fluoroscopy-guided procedures - Medication management - Ketamine-related care when applicable -------------------------------------------------- PSYCHIATRY / BEHAVIORAL HEALTH DOCUMENTATION -------------------------------------------------- Psychiatry or behavioral health experience is helpful. You should be comfortable documenting relevant history related to: - Depression - Anxiety - PTSD - Sleep problems - Mood symptoms - Functional impairment - Medication history - Treatment response - Safety concerns when discussed by the provider You are not making psychiatric decisions. You are documenting accurately under physician direction. -------------------------------------------------- WORKERS' COMPENSATION / IME EXPERIENCE -------------------------------------------------- Workers' Compensation or Independent Medical Evaluation experience is strongly preferred. Helpful experience includes documenting or summarizing: - Date of injury - Mechanism of injury - Work status - Job duties - Restrictions - Prior treatment chronology - Imaging history - Procedure history - Medication history - Functional limitations - MMI-related information - Impairment-related information - Causation-related history - Record review summaries - Contradictions or missing records You are not expected to make legal or medical conclusions. You are expected to organize the facts clearly for physician review. -------------------------------------------------- eCLINICALWORKS EXPERIENCE -------------------------------------------------- eClinicalWorks experience is strongly preferred. You should ideally be comfortable with: - Navigating patient charts - Reviewing prior notes - Reviewing medications - Updating medication lists - Updating allergies - Using templates - Creating or modifying templates - Creating favorites - Using structured data when possible - Drafting HPI, exam, assessment, and plan - Uploading or organizing records - Managing orders under provider direction - Preparing notes for physician review - Avoiding copy/paste errors - Avoiding outdated or inaccurate template language If you do not know eClinicalWorks but have strong medical scribing experience, you may still apply. However, eCW experience is a major advantage. -------------------------------------------------- LIVE CAMERA REQUIREMENT -------------------------------------------------- This is a synchronous live clinic role. During patient encounters and active clinic sessions, you must be on camera and attentive so you can follow the visit, observe the physician's exam instructions, and document accurately. This is important because the physician may ask you to capture physical exam findings, update the plan, locate prior records, or clarify documentation in real time. You must be comfortable with professional video presence during the shift. -------------------------------------------------- IMPORTANT DOCUMENTATION RULES -------------------------------------------------- You must never invent information. You must not invent: - Physical exam findings - Diagnoses - Patient symptoms - Medication use - Procedure response - Medical decision-making - Treatment plan - Work restrictions - Functional limitations You document what the patient says, what the physician says, what the physician observes, and what the physician directs. The physician reviews and signs the note. Accuracy is more important than speed. -------------------------------------------------- SECONDARY CLINICAL ADMIN TASKS -------------------------------------------------- When patient volume is lower, you may also help with clinical admin tasks such as: - Prior authorizations for medications or procedures - Gathering medical records - Requesting imaging reports - Organizing outside records - Summarizing records - Preparing visit charts - Preparing medical chronologies - Uploading documents - Faxing records - Tracking missing records - Helping improve templates - Helping create structured documentation workflows Prior authorization experience is preferred but not required on day one. -------------------------------------------------- TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS -------------------------------------------------- You must have: - Reliable computer - Dual monitors preferred - Wired internet preferred - Stable high-speed internet - Backup internet - Backup power source - Professional headset - Quiet private workspace - Webcam - Ability to use Microsoft Teams or similar video platform - Ability to use Time Doctor or other time tracking if required -------------------------------------------------- CONFIDENTIALITY / HIPAA -------------------------------------------------- This role involves access to sensitive medical information. You must follow strict confidentiality rules. You may not: - Discuss patient information outside work - Save patient information to your personal computer - Upload patient information to personal Google Drive, Dropbox, email , or messaging apps - Upload patient information to ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or any outside AI tool without written approval - Share logins - Allow another person to view patient encounters - Record patient visits - Take screenshots unless specifically approved - Subcontract the work A confidentiality agreement and HIPAA/BAA may be required before access is granted. -------------------------------------------------- FULL-TIME DEDICATED ROLE -------------------------------------------------- This is a full-time role during scheduled clinic hours. During paid working time, you may not: - Work for another client - Work for another agency - Monitor another client's messages - Keep another work laptop open - Attend another client's meetings - Run another time tracker - Subcontract your work - Share logins This role requires real-time attention during live patient encounters. It is not compatible with double-jobbing, overemployment, mouse jigglers, fake activity, or time padding. -------------------------------------------------- WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE -------------------------------------------------- A successful scribe will be able to: - Listen carefully during live visits - Capture accurate HPI details - Reconcile medications accurately - Document physical exam findings only as directed - Draft clean assessment and plan sections - Understand pain management terminology - Understand common medications - Understand basic psychiatry and behavioral health terminology - Summarize outside records clearly - Flag missing documentation - Improve templates over time - Communicate professionally with the physician - Ask smart questions when something is unclear - Finish notes quickly for physician review - Reduce the physician's documentation burden -------------------------------------------------- DO NOT APPLY IF -------------------------------------------------- Please do not apply if: - You cannot work the overnight/graveyard shift in the Philippines - You are looking for a daytime job - You cannot commit to at least 6 months - You are not comfortable being on camera during live clinic encounters - You only want transcription work after visits - You do not have strong English writing skills - You cannot type quickly and accurately - You do not understand medical terminology - You are not comfortable with pain management or psychiatry documentation - You are not comfortable with eClinicalWorks or learning EHR workflows - You cannot maintain confidentiality - You plan to work another job during our shift - You need constant step-by-step instruction after training - You are not willing to complete a live documentation test -------------------------------------------------- SELECTION PROCESS -------------------------------------------------- Qualified applicants may be asked to complete: - Written screening questions - Typing test - Short video interview - Live documentation exercise - Medical terminology test - eClinicalWorks navigation screen-share if applicable - Paid trial shift - 30-day probationary period - 90-day performance review We are not hiring based only on interview confidence. We are hiring based on live documentation skill, clinical understanding, communication, reliability, night-shift readiness, and ability to learn our documentation style. -------------------------------------------------- HOW TO APPLY -------------------------------------------------- Your application will only be considered if you follow these instructions. The first line of your application must be: PAIN SCRIBE NIGHT SHIFT Then answer these questions: 1. How many years of medical scribing or clinical documentation experience do you have? 2. What specialties have you scribed for? Examples: pain management, PM&R, orthopedics, spine, neurology, psychiatry, primary care, urgent care, ER, cardiology, etc. 3. Have you worked as a live real-time scribe during patient encounters, or only as a transcriptionist after visits? 4. What EHR/EMR systems have you used? Please specifically mention if you have used eClinicalWorks. 5. What is your typing speed in WPM? Please include a recent typing test result if available. 6. What is your healthcare background? (This is the #1 requirement and we will assess it from your video — see below.) Excellent written English — natural and friendly over text Comfortable and confident making and taking phone calls (this is a phone-forward role) Reliable and self-managing across a 7-day schedule — consistency matters more than long hours Fast and responsive — quick replies and quick dials are what book calls Experience with chat/SMS, phone, or CRM tools (SendBlue, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, dialers — a plus) Available on U.S. Eastern hours, including weekends Stable internet, a quiet place to take calls, a reliable computer, and a good headset Bonus (not required): Prior appointment-setting, sales, telemarketing, customer support, or live-chat experience Experience working with U.S.-based leads or customers COMPENSATION DETAILS Base: $4 USD/hour for scheduled hours (~20–25 hrs/week) Booked-call bonus: $5 USD for every qualified booked call "Qualified" = the lead confirms a specific date/time, has a real Canadian-born parent or grandparent, and is genuinely interested. (We pay for quality bookings, not junk.) Paid weekly or bi-weekly (your preference) Long-term role. Reliable performers get raises and more hours. HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY — incomplete applications are deleted) 1. Start your message with the word "MAPLE" at the very top, so I know you actually read this. 2. Record a short custom video (2–3 minutes) — THIS IS REQUIRED. No video = no consideration. In the video: Introduce yourself on camera, speaking in English so we can hear you clearly Tell us specifically why YOU are a good fit for THIS role — not a generic intro. Mention that it's a text + phone setting role and that you'd be calling warm leads about Canadian citizenship. Reusing an old generic VA video will be obvious; we want one made for this job. Briefly describe any experience you have calling or texting leads, setting appointments, or doing sales/support End with this: pretend a lead just said "How do I know this is even legit?" — say out loud, in your own words, exactly how you'd respond to keep them comfortable and move toward booking a quick call. Upload it to Google Drive, YouTube (unlisted), or Loom and paste the link. 3. In writing, tell me: your available hours per week, and which days/times (in U.S. Eastern time) you can work. Applications that don't start with "MAPLE" or don't include the custom video will not be reviewed. We'll run a short paid trial with real conversations before any long-term offer. Strong setters stay on long-term. Looking forward to hearing your voice!

title: Media Buyer Needed — Strategic Proposal Request for Paid Ads Launch
job_title: Media Buyer Needed — Strategic Proposal Request for Paid Ads Launch
description: Media Buyer Needed — Strategic Proposal Request for Paid Ads Launch Background We are looking for an experienced media buyer to review our offer and provide a clear campaign proposal outlining how you would launch, test, and scale paid advertising for our business. Our Meta ad account / Instagram account is currently suspended, and Meta has been experiencing significant account restrictions and ban waves. Because of this, we are looking for a media buyer who can objectively assess our situation and recommend the most viable platform and strategy based on current market conditions rather than defaulting to a single advertising channel. We are not looking for someone to simply "run ads." We are looking for a strategic partner who can evaluate our situation, recommend the best path forward, and provide a well-thought-out acquisition plan before any campaign begins. Business Context Our offer is a done-for-you prop firm passing service targeted toward aspiring traders and individuals who have struggled to successfully pass prop firm evaluations on their own. Our audience primarily consists of: Aspiring funded traders Traders who have previously failed prop firm challenges Individuals interested in trading as an income-generating skill Traders seeking assistance navigating the prop firm evaluation process Because this is a trading-related offer, please clearly state whether you have previous experience advertising within the trading, forex, futures, crypto, investing, prop firm, funded account, or financial education industries. If applicable, please include relevant case studies, performance metrics, lessons learned, and any compliance or advertising challenges you have encountered within these industries. Business Stage This is a new business launch. We currently have: No previous ad campaign data No historical CPA benchmarks No historical ROAS benchmarks No existing pixel or conversion data No proven winning audiences No established retargeting pools No prior paid traffic results We understand that the initial campaign phase will involve testing, validation, audience discovery, creative testing, and data collection. We are specifically looking for a media buyer who can create a realistic launch strategy for a business starting from scratch and explain how they would progress from initial testing to a scalable acquisition system. Budget We are starting with a budget of approximately $1,000–$1,500 for Month 1. This is intended as an initial testing budget and is not our long-term ceiling. If performance supports scaling, we are prepared to increase spend beginning in Month 2 and continue scaling in subsequent months. What We Need From You Please submit a proposal that includes the following: 1. Recommended Platform Which platform would you launch on first? Why do you believe this platform is the best fit for our offer, audience, budget, and current account situation? If recommending TikTok, YouTube, Google, Meta (if available), X, or another platform, explain your reasoning. 2. Launch Strategy Please explain: Campaign structure Targeting approach Creative strategy Funnel structure Website sales vs. DMs vs. lead generation Testing methodology 3. Forecast & Performance Expectations Please provide realistic projections for: Month 1 Month 2 Month 3 Include estimated: Traffic volume Clicks Conversions Cost per result Customer acquisition cost Revenue projections ROAS assumptions Key risks and assumptions behind the forecast 4. Scaling Plan Please explain: How you would determine whether a campaign is ready to scale What KPIs you would monitor Budget increases you would recommend How strategy would evolve between Month 1, Month 2, and Month 3 5. Creative & Testing Strategy Please outline: What creative formats you would test first Number of ad variations Hooks and messaging angles Creative testing framework Any additional assets you would recommend creating 6. Risk & Compliance Considerations Because this is a trading-related offer, please explain: Potential advertising risks Platform-specific restrictions Compliance concerns How you would minimize the likelihood of ad disapprovals, account issues, or policy violations Additional Information To Include Please also provide: Relevant experience Similar industries worked with Case studies or performance examples Management fee and what is included Whether you provide strategy, copywriting, creative direction, or creative production Expected timeline to launch Communication and reporting process Proposal Requirements Please do not submit generic proposals. We are specifically looking for: A recommended platform selection with supporting reasoning A launch plan tailored to our business Month 1–3 projections Budget allocation recommendations Expected KPIs and success metrics Scaling methodology Risks and assumptions behind your forecast The stronger your strategic thinking, the more likely you are to be considered. Decision Criteria We will not necessarily choose the lowest-cost media buyer. We will select the candidate who demonstrates the strongest understanding of: Paid acquisition strategy Forecasting and performance expectations Platform selection Scaling methodology Risk management Performance marketing fundamentals The quality of your proposal, reasoning, and strategic approach will be a major factor in our decision. To Apply Please send: A brief introduction Your proposed platform and reasoning Month 1–3 projections Your fee structure Relevant case studies or proof of results Any additional recommendations you believe we should consider We look forward to reviewing thoughtful, data-driven proposals from experienced media buyers who can help us build a scalable acquisition strategy from the ground up.

description: Genesis Pain Clinic is a US-based interventional pain management clinic looking for an experienced part-time Provider Enrollment & Credentialing Specialist. This is not a general VA role. This is not an entry-level healthcare admin role. This is not basic insurance verification. This is a credentialing, payer enrollment, provider enrollment, and compliance tracking role. We are a small specialty medical clinic with one physician provider and one primary clinic location. We need someone who can organize and maintain credentialing, payer enrollment, CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, license renewals, DEA renewals, hospital/surgery center privileges, and payer follow-up. Initial workload may be 5-10 hours per week while we clean up existing files, update profiles, and resolve open credentialing issues. Long-term maintenance may average 5-10 hours per month, depending on payer recredentialing, license renewals, hospital privileges, and new enrollment needs. Pay: $8-$12 USD per hour depending on verified experience. Schedule: Part-time, flexible schedule. Must be available for scheduled check-ins. Paid time must be focused only on our credentialing work. -------------------------------------------------- REQUIRED EXPERIENCE ------------------------------------------ ---------- to 5 years of US healthcare credentialing or provider enrollment experience - Hands-on CAQH experience - Hands-on PECOS / Medicare provider enrollment experience - NPPES / NPI update experience - Commercial payer enrollment experience - Experience submitting and tracking payer applications - Experience following up with payers by portal, email , and phone - Experience maintaining credentialing trackers or spreadsheets - Strong written English - Strong attention to detail - Ability to work independently - High confidentiality and professionalism -------------------------------------------------- STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE -------------------------------------------------- - Physician practice credentialing - Specialty clinic credentialing - Pain management, anesthesia, orthopedic, spine, PM&R, neurology, ASC, or procedural-specialty experience - Hospital or surgery center privileging - Medicare and Medicaid enrollment - Commercial payer enrollment with BCBS, UHC/Optum, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, and regional payers - EFT / ERA / EDI enrollment - Payer contracting support - Recredentialing and revalidation - Workers' Compensation network enrollment - Experience handling sensitive provider disclosures, malpractice history, training gaps, licensure questions, or application explanations - CPES, CPCS, CPMSM, CPB, CPC, or other healthcare credentialing/billing certification Certifications are preferred but not required. Real hands-on credentialing experience matters more than certificates. -------------------------------------------------- MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES -------------------------------------------------- You may be responsible for: - Maintaining CAQH profile - Uploading and updating CAQH documents - CAQH attestations / re-attestations - Authorizing payer access in CAQH - Maintaining PECOS / Medicare enrollment information - Tracking Medicare revalidations - Maintaining NPPES / NPI information - Updating taxonomy, address, contact, and practice information - Submitting commercial payer enrollment applications - Tracking payer application status - Following up with payers until approval - Confirming payer effective dates - Supporting payer contracting paperwork - Supporting EFT / ERA / EDI setup - Helping connect payer approvals to billing/clearinghouse workflow - Tracking payer portal logins and status updates - Maintaining a credentialing tracker - Maintaining a license / DEA / CME / malpractice renewal calendar - Assisting with hospital and surgery center privilege applications - Tracking hospital reappointment deadlines - Organizing peer references and privilege documents - Organizing malpractice insurance certificates and loss runs - Organizing board certification, CME, ACLS/BLS, and other documents - Organizing sensitive disclosure documents for provider review - Preparing weekly or monthly status reports -------------------------------------------------- CONFIDENTIALITY REQUIREMENT -------------------------------------------------- This role involves sensitive physician credentialing information. You may see private information related to medical licenses, malpractice history, training history, insurance applications, hospital privileges, DEA registration, government portals, and payer applications. You must be extremely confidential. You may not: - Share clinic or provider information - Save documents to your personal computer - Upload documents to your personal Google Drive, Dropbox, or email - Forward clinic documents to outside accounts - Upload clinic documents into ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or any outside AI tool without written approval - Share logins - Subcontract the work - Allow another person to access our documents or portals A confidentiality agreement and HIPAA/BAA may be required before access is granted. -------------------------------------------------- SENSITIVE DISCLOSURE RULE -------------------------------------------------- Some credentialing applications ask sensitive yes/no questions about malpractice claims, training history, licensure history, hospital privileges, investigations, or professional issues. You are not expected to make legal or professional judgment calls. Your responsibility is to: - Flag every sensitive disclosure question - Organize the requested information - Draft a clear factual summary if asked - Send the question and draft to the physician for review - Wait for physician approval before submission - Never guess - Never hide information - Never answer a sensitive question without approval - Never submit an application with incomplete or inaccurate disclosure information Accuracy, honesty, and confidentiality are mandatory. -------------------------------------------------- TRACKING AND REPORTING -------------------------------------------------- Every application or follow-up must be documented. Your credentialing tracker should include: - Payer or facility name - Portal used - Application type - Date started - Date submitted - Confirmation number - Reference number - Contact person - Current status - Missing items - Next follow-up date - Approval date - Effective date - EFT / ERA / EDI status if applicable - Notes and blockers A short weekly status report will be required. Weekly report should include: - Applications submitted - Applications pending - Payers or facilities contacted - Reference numbers obtained - Missing documents needed from physician - Sensitive disclosure questions needing physician review - Renewals coming due - Problems or delays - Next week priorities -------------------------------------------------- WORK STYLE -------------------------------------------------- This is a part-time role, but paid time must be focused on our work. During paid working time: - You must work only on our credentialing tasks - You may not bill time while working for another client - You may not subcontract the work - You must document actual work completed - You must update the credentialing tracker - You must be available for scheduled check-ins - You must be able to explain what you completed This role is best for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, experienced, confidential, and able to work independently. -------------------------------------------------- DO NOT APPLY IF -------------------------------------------------- Please do not apply if: - You have no US healthcare credentialing experience - You have never used CAQH - You have never used PECOS - You do not understand provider enrollment - You only know insurance verification - You only know medical billing but not credentialing - You cannot maintain a detailed tracker - You are not comfortable with sensitive confidential information - You need to be trained from the beginning - You cannot follow up with payers consistently - You cannot work independently - You plan to subcontract this role - You are not willing to complete a live screen-share skills test -------------------------------------------------- SELECTION PROCESS -------------------------------------------------- Qualified applicants may be asked to complete: - Written screening questions - Short video interview - Live screen-share workflow test - Credentialing tracker review - Paid trial task - 30-day probationary period We are not hiring based on interview confidence. We are hiring based on demonstrated credentialing skill, organization, confidentiality, and follow-through. -------------------------------------------------- HOW TO APPLY -------------------------------------------------- Your application will only be considered if you follow these instructions. The first line of your application must be: CREDENTIALING EXPERT - CAQH PECOS Then answer these questions: 1. How many years of US healthcare credentialing or provider enrollment experience do you have? 2. Have you personally worked in CAQH? Describe exactly what tasks you performed. 3. Have you personally worked in PECOS? Describe exactly what tasks you performed. 4. Have you personally updated NPPES / NPI information? What types of updates have you done? 5. Which commercial payers have you credentialed providers with? Examples: BCBS, UHC/Optum, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid plans, regional payers. 6. Have you handled hospital or surgery center privilege applications? If yes, describe your experience. 7. Have you handled Medicare revalidation, Medicaid enrollment, or payer recredentialing? Give examples. 8. Have you handled EFT / ERA / EDI enrollment after payer approval? Explain your workflow. 9. What credentialing tracker or spreadsheet have you used? Describe the columns you would include. 10. Describe a time when a payer application was stuck, returned incomplete, or delayed. What did you do to fix it? 11. Have you ever handled sensitive provider disclosures such as malpractice history, training gaps, licensure questions, or disciplinary questions? How did you handle confidentiality and provider approval? 12. What certifications do you have, if any? Examples: CPES, CPCS, CPMSM, CPB, CPC, healthcare administration, medical billing, credentialing training. 13. Are you currently working for other clients? If yes, list your current schedule and confirm that you will not bill us while working for another client. 14. What is your requested hourly rate in USD? 15. Are you available for a live screen-share test where you walk through a sample CAQH / PECOS / payer enrollment workflow? -------------------------------------------------- MINI TEST QUESTION -------------------------------------------------- A solo physician is already in-network with some payers, but the CAQH profile, NPPES profile, malpractice certificate, DEA certificate, and payer enrollment tracker may be outdated. Walk me through exactly how you would audit and clean up the credentialing file during the first 30 days. prospects by phone using provided criteria Schedule showings on the showing assistant's calendar Send showing confirmations and reminders Follow up persistently with leads and applicants who go quiet checklists to qualified prospects Update all rental listings across Zillow, TurboTenant, Facebook Marketplace, and Facebook Groups Monitor listing inboxes across all platforms Prepare weekly pipeline and vacancy status reports Phase Two — Systems, Investor Support, and Brand Operations (ongoing and expanding): CRM and Systems: Build and manage workflows and automations in GoHighLevel Build and maintain task structures, templates, and workflows in ClickUp Build and monitor automation scenarios in ---------- Manage investor and buyer leads in CRM: enter contacts, update pipeline stages, log notes Send follow-up messages to investor and homeowner leads using approved scripts Coordinate calls and appointments between the founder and clients Organize deal documents and correspondence in Google Drive Pull weekly reports from GHL and summarize in plain language Content and Social Media Operations: Manage the content calendar in ClickUp across all platforms Schedule and publish approved content on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook , and TikTok using scheduling tools Support YouTube production operations: organize video files, manage upload schedules, draft descriptions and tags using provided direction Monitor comments and messages across platforms, flag priority items for founder response Track weekly engagement metrics and compile a simple report: reach, followers, saves, shares, views Repurpose long-form content into short-form captions and clip descriptions as directed Administrative: Manage daily tasks and priorities in ClickUp Monitor the dedicated operations email inbox Draft routine email and message responses for founder review and approval Organize files and documents in Google Drive Schedule and confirm appointments on the founder's calendar What We Are Looking For: Required: Phone confidence in English. You will be calling and receiving calls from US-based rental prospects, tenants, vendors, contractors, and investors. Your spoken English must be clear and professional. This will be evaluated in your Loom video and confirmed in the interview. Candidates from BPO or US-facing call center backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. Systems and automation experience. You must have hands-on experience building or managing workflows in at least one of the following: GoHighLevel, ---------- , ClickUp automations, or a comparable CRM automation tool. Knowing how to use a tool is not enough. We need someone who has built something in it. Be specific in your application about what you built. Follow-through without being reminded. This operation has many open items running simultaneously. Leads that do not get followed up fall through. Vendors that are not chased miss deadlines. You close every loop. We need a specific real example from your work history, not a general claim. Project management tool experience. ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or equivalent. You will live in ClickUp daily. Detail orientation you can prove with a specific story. Reliable fast internet and a quiet dedicated workspace for calls. Non-negotiable. Strongly preferred: GoHighLevel experience specifically. Pipelines, workflows, automations, campaigns, and conversation management. ---------- experience. Building multi-step scenarios, not just connecting two apps. Social media scheduling and content operations experience. Meta Business Suite, social media scheduling tools. Real estate experience of any kind. Property management, leasing, investor support, mortgage, title, or transaction coordination. Experience supporting a US-based entrepreneur or small business owner directly. Bonus Skills That Will Make You Stand Out These are not required to apply. Candidates who have any of the following will have a meaningful advantage and should highlight them clearly in their Loom video and written summary: Spanish fluency. We work with a large Spanish-speaking investor, tenant, vendor, and buyer population in Central Florida. A bilingual candidate is a significant operational asset. Canva or basic graphic design. Ability to produce clean one-pagers, deal flyers, and social media graphics from existing templates without needing a separate designer. YouTube channel management. Experience with upload workflows, SEO-optimized descriptions, tags, thumbnails coordination, and channel analytics. Transaction coordination familiarity. Basic understanding of what happens between a real estate contract and closing — document collection, timeline tracking, lender and title communication. Video editing basics. Ability to do simple cuts, captions, and formatting in CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or a comparable tool. If you have any of these, tell us specifically in your Loom video. It will strengthen your application considerably. What This Role Offers Direct access to the founder with no management layers between you. A 12-month contract with real stability and strong renewal potential. Weekly pay. A role that grows with you — phase one builds your operational foundation, phase two puts you at the center of a brand that is actively being built. If you want to grow your skills in real estate operations, CRM automation, and content production for a personal brand in the real estate investing space, this role will develop you fast. How to Apply Do not send a generic application. Do not use AI to write your cover message. Applications that do not follow these exact instructions will not be reviewed. Submit the following two things: One — A Loom video, 3 to 5 minutes maximum. Answer these three questions in the video: Tell me about a role where you made or received calls in English to US clients, tenants, customers, or vendors. What were the calls about and how did you handle a situation where the person on the other end was frustrated, confused, or unresponsive? Tell me about something specific you built in a CRM or automation tool. Not something you managed or used — something you actually built. Walk me through what it was and how it worked. Your job is to look at that material and think: “There’s a story here.” “That’s the hook.” “This should be a Reel, not a graphic.” “We can get five pieces of content from this conversation.” “Craig should record something about this.” Or, best of all: “I have an idea.” What You’ll Do You’ll take ownership of GigLogic’s day-to-day social media and content presence, including: · Developing original content ideas · Identifying stories and opportunities in existing material · Creating and maintaining a thoughtful content calendar · Writing captions, hooks, posts, and social copy · Editing short-form video · Creating graphics and carousels · Repurposing podcasts, interviews, articles, and videos into multiple pieces of content · Publishing and scheduling content · Helping manage social engagement and community interaction · Watching trends without blindly chasing them · Reviewing performance and identifying what’s working · Recommending what we should do more of, less of, or differently · Proactively asking for the raw material you need · Bringing new ideas to us rather than waiting for us to bring every idea to you Who We’re Looking For You should be: · An excellent English communicator, both written and spoken · A strong writer · A creative and strategic thinker · Comfortable editing short-form video · Visually capable with tools such as Canva · Curious and interested in understanding the ideas behind a business · Organized, dependable, and able to work independently · Comfortable offering your opinion — even when you disagree with the founder · Someone who notices opportunities other people miss Professional social media or content experience is important. Experience in music or entertainment is helpful, but not required. We would rather hire an exceptional content thinker who can learn our industry than an industry expert who cannot tell a great story. About GigLogic GigLogic helps working performers understand what a professional opportunity will actually pay them before they say yes. The fee for a gig is not necessarily what the performer takes home. Travel, musicians, crew, production, commissions, taxes, lodging, and other expenses can dramatically change the real financial value of an opportunity. That’s why one of our core beliefs is: The paycheck isn’t the profit. GigLogic gives performers the information they need to make smarter professional decisions and build more sustainable careers. Compensation & Commitment This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position. Starting salary: $1,000 USD per month. We are open to hearing from exceptional candidates whose compensation expectations differ, and the application will give you an opportunity to tell us what you would require. Working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time. Because this role works closely with our founder throughout the day, you must be comfortable consistently working this schedule from the Philippines. This is intended to be your primary full-time professional commitment. We are looking for someone who can dedicate their scheduled working hours to GigLogic rather than dividing that time among multiple clients or employers. We are also looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, not a short freelance project or temporary assignment. How to Apply Please complete our application here: ---------- We care much more about your actual work, judgment, communication, and ideas than about degrees or impressive job titles. Please read the application carefully and answer the questions yourself. We want to hear your voice, not what you think the perfect applicant is supposed to say. One important detail: When you reach the final question in the application, begin your answer with the word GIG. ***NOTE: Applications that simply send a résumé or generic message through OnlineJobs.ph without completing the application will not be considered.*** If this sounds like the kind of role where you’d do your best work, we’d like to hear from you.
