title: Admin, Cleaning & Finance Coordinator
description: Stayful | Full-time, fully remote | UK business hours THE BASICS Type: Full-time, fully remote Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday Rate: $5 per hour during the three month trial, reviewed to $6 per hour for the right person Availability: UK business hours, 9am to 5pm GMT/BST Contract: 3 month paid trial, then ongoing Start: As soon as possible Reference: STAY-CFC (must be included in your application) Please read before applying: this role requires availability during UK business hours, 9am to 5pm GMT/BST. From the Philippines that is 5pm to 1am Philippine Standard Time. If you are not available during these hours, please do not apply. ABOUT US Stayful is a UK based property management company. We manage around 60 short stay properties on Airbnb, ---------- and other channels on behalf of UK property owners. Most of our team is based in the Philippines and we operate fully remotely. We run as a group of three companies: Stayful Ltd, the main operating company Stayful Bookings Ltd, our booking agency Stayful Systems, our software company building tools for the short stay industry This role sits across the two property businesses. We are a small company. There is no layer of middle management, nobody looking over your shoulder, and nobody to pick up the pieces if something is left unfinished. That means real ownership, real influence, and real responsibility. WHAT THIS ROLE IS This role brings together two sides of the business that depend on each other. Cleaner management. Our cleaners and cleaning companies are not scheduled by us. Once a cleaner is assigned to a property they plan their own rota and report their cleans through our systems. Your job is to manage them: build the relationship, monitor what they deliver, hold them to standard, and step in the moment quality slips. Invoice verification and records. When a cleaner or contractor invoices us, you are the person who checks it against what was actually reported and completed before it is approved for payment. You are the last line of defence on every payment this company makes. These two functions sit together for a reason. The person managing the cleaners is the person who knows whether the clean happened, who did it, and whether the invoice matches reality. Nobody is better placed to catch an error, a duplicate or an overcharge. On top of this you will handle general company administration: staff rotas and records, payroll submission, and the day to day admin that keeps a remote business running. You will report directly to Martyn, our Director. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Cleaner management and performance Our cleaners have autonomy over their own scheduling. You are not assigning individual cleans. You are managing the people and the standard. Own the relationship with every cleaner and cleaning company on our books. They should know you, trust you, and come to you first when there is a problem Monitor performance continuously using completion reports, photos, guest reviews and guest feedback Give each cleaner performance feedback every week: what is working, what is not, and what needs to change Hold cleaners to standard even when they would rather not engage. Cleaners are busy and regular check ins are easy for them to avoid, so you will need to be persuasive, persistent and firm when the situation calls for it Raise problems directly, promptly and fairly, then follow up until they are genuinely resolved. Never let something slide because chasing it is awkward Track recurring issues by cleaner and by property, and fix the underlying cause rather than patching the symptom every time Keep a written record of every check in and every issue raised 2. Guest flexibility and cleaning policy compliance Work with cleaners to accommodate early check ins and late checkouts wherever possible. These affect guest experience and revenue directly, and are worth the effort to arrange Make sure our mid stay cleaning policy is followed: the cleans happen, on time, to standard Make sure our deep cleaning policy is followed: cleans are booked in, completed on time, and verified rather than assumed Verify completion through our systems and chase anything that has not been reported 3. Cleaner recruitment and onboarding Find, vet and onboard new cleaners and cleaning companies, both to replace those who leave or underperform, and to set us up in new areas as we grow Agree rates and terms, brief new cleaners fully on our standards, and set them up in our systems Maintain a pipeline of potential cleaners so that losing one is never a crisis 4. Weekly reporting to management Produce a weekly written report covering every cleaner: how they are performing, any issues and their status, and any opportunities you have spotted Escalate significant problems as they happen rather than saving them for the report. Management should never be surprised by something you already knew 5. Invoice verification and payment control Verify every incoming cleaning and contractor invoice before it is approved: correct supplier, correct property, correct date, correct rate, correct total Cross check every invoiced clean against what was reported and completed in our systems. If a clean was not carried out, it does not get paid Identify and challenge duplicates, double charges, rate changes that were never agreed, and invoices from suppliers we no longer work with Query discrepancies directly with the supplier and resolve them, rather than passing them straight up the line Log and process approved invoices through Apron and Xero Chase missing invoices so costs land in the right month and nothing arrives as a surprise 6. Financial records Keep income and expense records accurate, current and correctly categorised Maintain the cashflow records in Google Sheets and keep the Stayful Finance Dashboard up to date Flag discrepancies between the cashflow records, the invoices and the accounts as soon as you spot them Send Martyn a short written weekly summary: what has been processed, what has been flagged, what is outstanding 7. Rotas, payroll and company admin Keep staff rotas accurate and up to date, and arrange shift cover in advance rather than in a scramble Maintain team records: hours logged, leave, onboarding documents, contact details Prepare and submit payroll on time and correctly, checking hours and rates before submission rather than after Handle general company administration: document management, supplier records, filing and renewals Keep our processes and SOPs current, and write new ones where there is a gap WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Three qualities matter more than anything else in this role. Attention to detail. You check things properly. You do not tick a box because a message was sent, and you do not approve an invoice because it looks roughly right. You compare it against what actually happened, and if the two do not match, you find out why. Problem solving. When something is wrong, you take responsibility for putting it right. You use your initiative and work the problem through. Asking for help when you are genuinely stuck is fine and encouraged. Handing every difficulty straight to someone else to solve is not. The confidence to hold people to account. You are comfortable being the person who chases. Our cleaners are busy and independent, and would generally rather get on with the job than take a weekly call. You will need to be persuasive and firm when firmness is what the situation needs, while keeping the relationship a good one. Both halves matter. Someone who cannot be direct will let standards drift, and someone who is only direct will lose us good cleaners. What will not work here is leaving things unchecked or unanswered, or quietly hoping a problem goes unnoticed. We would far rather hear about a mistake immediately than find it three months later in the accounts. Raising a problem you spotted is never held against you. Hiding one is. Essential Demonstrable attention to detail in work where errors have a real cost, with specific examples you can talk us through Experience verifying, checking or reconciling invoices, timesheets, payments or similar records Experience managing contractors, suppliers or field staff you did not directly supervise, including chasing them and having the difficult conversation when work is not right Strong written and spoken English. You will be speaking and writing to UK based cleaners and suppliers every day Organised and reliable with deadlines and reporting, across many properties and moving parts at once Comfortable with spreadsheets and digital tools, and quick to learn new systems Able to work independently and manage your own workload without daily supervision Available during UK business hours, 9am to 5pm GMT/BST. This is a firm requirement Desirable Experience in property management, short term rentals, hospitality or facilities Experience managing cleaning, housekeeping or maintenance providers Experience recruiting or sourcing contractors and negotiating rates Xero experience, or bookkeeping and accounts payable experience Familiarity with Apron or a similar invoice management tool Experience running payroll or managing staff rotas and time records Experience writing or improving SOPs and processes WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE The person who does well here will bring ideas to the table, not just complete tasks. If you can see a better way to monitor cleaner quality, a tighter way to check invoices, or a report that would give us visibility we currently lack, propose it and build it. We are actively bringing AI into how our team works so that a small team can do more, to a higher standard, in less time. We want someone curious about this and willing to use these tools to work smarter, not someone nervous of them. If you already use AI tools in your work, tell us how. Beyond the work itself, we want someone who is easy to work with and a pleasure to have on the team. We are a small group working remotely across time zones, so being straightforward, communicative and good natured matters here. This is a full time role from day one. The rate starts at $5 per hour for the three month trial, and we expect to review it to $6 per hour for the right person once that is complete. We are a growing group of companies, and people who show initiative here get the first opportunity when new work comes up. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF You are not available during UK business hours. This is a firm requirement with no flexibility You are looking for part time work, or you have other commitments that would prevent you giving this role a full working week You find it uncomfortable to chase people, push back on them, or have a direct conversation about work that is not good enough You need constant direction, or you escalate every problem rather than attempting to solve it first You would rather leave something ambiguous than ask the question that resolves it You want a narrow, single task role. This one covers cleaner management, finance checking and general admin Being accountable for the accuracy of payments feels like too much pressure TOOLS YOU WILL USE Uplisting. Property management system: bookings, calendars and cleaning records WhatsApp. Day to day communication with cleaners and contractors Xero. Accounting platform across both entities Apron. Invoice management and approvals, integrated with Xero Google Sheets. Cleaner records, cashflow records and supporting documentation Stayful Finance Dashboard. Our internal platform for cash position and financial data Connecteam. Rotas, time tracking and team records. You will log your own hours here and submit a matching invoice each Friday Asana. Task and project tracking. Your work should be visible here without being asked for Slack. Day to day communication with Martyn and the team Google Meet. Weekly check in with Martyn Claude (AI). We use AI across the business to work faster and more accurately. You will be trained and supported in using it HOW TO APPLY Applications are only accepted through our application form. Please do not send a message through OnlineJobs.ph. Applications sent that way will not be considered. You must include the reference STAY-CFC in your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed. Apply here: ---------- In your application, please tell us about: A time you spotted an error that others had missed, and what you did about it A time you had to push a contractor or supplier to improve their work, and how you handled it A problem you solved on your own initiative rather than escalating Generic applications will not be considered.

title: eCommerce Virtual Assistant
description: We're expanding our remote team and looking for a dependable, driven, and detail-oriented eCommerce Virtual Assistant who is interested in building a long-term career with us. We're a Philippines-based agency managing multiple eCommerce brands for clients around the world. This position is ideal for someone who is serious about their work, learns quickly, takes ownership, and wants to develop valuable skills in the digital eCommerce industry. This is not a slow-paced or passive VA position. We manage several client accounts, so your workload may vary from day to day. Some days may involve multiple tasks, urgent changes, tight deadlines, and shifting priorities. We're looking for someone who can remain organized, follow processes accurately, work efficiently under pressure, and consistently deliver quality work—even during busy periods. If you're proactive, responsible, organized, and capable of working independently, this could be an excellent long-term opportunity. About the Position Start Date: Immediate Schedule: Graveyard shift, Philippine time Work Days: Monday–Friday Weekends: Off Employment Type: Full-time, long-term Occasional overtime may be required when urgent client requests, important deadlines, or time-sensitive updates come up. This will not be an everyday requirement, but flexibility is important in a fast-moving eCommerce environment. Key Responsibilities You will help manage the day-to-day operations of multiple eCommerce brands. Your responsibilities may include: Managing and maintaining Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon stores Creating, editing, and improving product listings Conducting product, competitor, and market research Assisting with customer service and order processing Performing website updates and general administrative tasks Supporting marketing and content-related activities Creating basic graphics and marketing visuals using Canva Making simple website layout and design improvements Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve productivity and accuracy Following company systems, SOPs, checklists, and instructions Managing multiple tasks across different client accounts Responding promptly to task updates and requests during working hours Keeping tasks organized and on schedule during high-volume periods As you gain experience and demonstrate reliability, you'll gradually be given more responsibility, including the opportunity to manage client accounts with greater independence and take on higher-value projects. Requirements We're looking for someone who: Learns quickly and can solve problems independently Is highly organized and pays close attention to detail Takes ownership and accountability for their work Can follow instructions accurately and meet deadlines Communicates clearly and professionally Has a strong work ethic and proactive attitude Can perform well in a fast-paced environment Handles urgent requests and pressure professionally Has their own reliable laptop or desktop computer Has a stable, high-speed internet connection Can be fully available throughout the assigned working hours Does not have another job, client, business, or personal commitment that could interfere with their availability, focus, schedule, or performance Nice-to-Have Skills These are helpful but not mandatory: Shopify experience Canva or basic graphic design experience An eye for clean layouts, spacing, and visual presentation Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools Basic video editing skills using CapCut Previous experience in virtual assistance, eCommerce, customer service, or administration Experience is not everything. We value discipline, attitude, consistency, honesty, and reliability more than simply having years of experience. Technical skills can be trained, but we expect the right mindset and commitment from the beginning. Compensation & Career Growth Monthly Salary: ₱25,000–₱30,000 Monthly Performance Bonus: ₱5,000–₱8,000 Opportunities for regular salary increases based on performance Clear opportunities for promotion and increased responsibility Potential progression into senior and leadership positions Long-term stability for consistently strong performers Why Work With Us? You'll have the opportunity to: Build a stable, long-term career with an established eCommerce agency Work within structured systems and processes Receive clear guidance, training, and performance feedback Develop practical skills across Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and TikTok Shop Work with AI, automation, and modern digital tools Gain hands-on experience with international eCommerce businesses Develop skills that can lead to senior-level and leadership opportunities This Role Is Not for Everyone We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and completes the bare minimum. We need someone who takes initiative, works efficiently, thinks critically, stays focused, and takes ownership of results. The workload can be demanding at times, and priorities can change quickly. You should be comfortable adapting, handling multiple responsibilities, and maintaining quality even when things get busy. We're specifically looking for someone who wants to grow with the company for the long term. If you're only looking for a temporary position, side income, an easy job, or something you can do alongside another commitment, this role will likely not be a good fit. How to Apply Please submit the following: Updated resume Internet speed test result Computer specifications, including: Device/model Processor RAM Storage Short cover letter introducing yourself, describing your relevant experience, and explaining why you believe you're a good fit for this position Important Application Instruction Please include "ECOMMERCE VA" in your email subject line. Applications without this phrase may not be considered, as we want to make sure applicants have carefully read the entire job post. Final Note This is intended to be a long-term position with genuine opportunities for career development. We're looking for someone who is ready to commit fully to the role and become a dependable part of the team. You must not have other employment, clients, or commitments that could negatively affect your schedule, availability, concentration, productivity, or overall performance. If you're disciplined, motivated, willing to learn, and looking for an opportunity to build a serious career in eCommerce, we'd love to hear from you.
